  const MANUAL_PROFILE_FIELDS = ['active', 'sex', 'initial_stages', 'initial_offsets', 'initial_cycle_day', 'observation_paused', 'manual_observation', 'observation_memory'];
  const MANUAL_CALC_FIELDS = ['snapshot', 'archives', 'daily_anchor_archives', 'conception_event_ledger', 'conception_decision_ledger', 'active_conception_decisions', 'sexual_desire_profiles', 'stamina_profiles'];

  function manualBranchIndex(messages) {
    const index = new Map();
    let prefix = sha256Hex('manual-state-history-v1');
    for (const message of [...(messages || [])].filter(item => Number.isInteger(item?.message_id)).sort((a,b) => a.message_id - b.message_id)) {
      const identity = { ...externalMessageIdentity(message), role: String(message.role || '') };
      prefix = sha256Hex(`${prefix}|${JSON.stringify(identity)}`);
      index.set(message.message_id, { ...identity, prefix_sha256: prefix });
    }
    return index;
  }

  function manualPatchAllowed(path) {
    if (!Array.isArray(path) || !path.every(key => typeof key === 'string' && key.length && key.length <= 250)
      || path.some(key => ['__proto__','prototype','constructor'].includes(key))) return false;
    if (path[0] === 'character_profiles') return path.length === 3 && MANUAL_PROFILE_FIELDS.includes(path[2]);
    if (path[0] === 'effect_dismissals') return path.length === 2;
    if (path[0] === 'stamina_profiles') return path.length === 2;
    if (path[0] === 'archives') return path.length === 2;
    if (['conception_decision_ledger','active_conception_decisions'].includes(path[0])) return path.length === 2;
    if (path[0] === 'conception_event_ledger') return path.length === 3 && ['closed','resolution','notice_pending'].includes(path[2]);
    if (path[0] !== 'snapshot' || path[1] !== 'characters' || path.length < 3) return false;
    if (path.length === 3) return true;
    if (['mode', 'sex'].includes(path[3])) return path.length === 4;
    if (path[3] === 'needs') return path.length === 5 && NEED_KEYS.includes(path[4]);
    if (path[3] === 'effects') return path.length === 5 && EFFECT_ID_RE.test(path[4]) && path[4] !== CYCLE_PRESENCE_KEY;
    if (path[3] === 'reproductive') return path.length === 4 || (path.length === 5 && REPRODUCTIVE_FIELDS.includes(path[4]))
      || (path.length === 6 && ['pregnancy','conception'].includes(path[4]) && ['user_awareness','character_awareness'].includes(path[5]));
    return false;
  }

  function manualHistory(store) {
    return (Array.isArray(store?.manual_state_edits) ? store.manual_state_edits : []).filter(row =>
      Number.isSafeInteger(row?.seq) && row.seq > 0 && Array.isArray(row.patches)
      && (row.anchor === null || (Number.isInteger(row.anchor?.message_id) && typeof row.anchor.content_sha256 === 'string' && typeof row.anchor.prefix_sha256 === 'string')))
      .map(row => ({ ...row, patches: row.patches.filter(p => manualPatchAllowed(p?.path) && typeof p.before_exists === 'boolean' && typeof p.after_exists === 'boolean'
        && (!p.before_exists || Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(p,'before')) && (!p.after_exists || Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(p,'after'))) }))
      .filter(row => row.patches.length).sort((a,b) => a.seq - b.seq);
  }

  function manualRowActive(row, index, limit = Infinity) {
    if (row.anchor === null) return true;
    if (row.anchor.message_id > limit) return false;
    const message = index.get(row.anchor.message_id);
    return message && message.swipe_id === row.anchor.swipe_id && message.role === row.anchor.role
      && message.content_sha256 === row.anchor.content_sha256 && message.prefix_sha256 === row.anchor.prefix_sha256;
  }

  function manualProjectionKey(store, messages, limit = Infinity) {
    const rows = manualHistory(store);
    if (!rows.length) return '';
    const index = manualBranchIndex(messages);
    const active = rows.filter(row => manualRowActive(row, index, limit));
    const end = Math.max(-1, Math.min(limit, store?.source_message_id ?? -1), ...active.map(row => row.anchor?.message_id ?? -1));
    return sha256Hex(JSON.stringify([index.get(end)?.prefix_sha256 || '', active.map(row => [row.seq,row.patches])]));
  }

  function manualValue(object, path) {
    let parent = object;
    for (const key of path) {
      if (!isPlainObject(parent) || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(parent, key)) return { exists:false };
      parent = parent[key];
    }
    return { exists:true, value:cloneJson(parent) };
  }

  function writeManualValue(object, path, exists, value) {
    let parent = object;
    for (const key of path.slice(0,-1)) {
      if (!isPlainObject(parent[key])) {
        if (!exists) return;
        parent[key] = {};
      }
      parent = parent[key];
    }
    if (exists) parent[path.at(-1)] = cloneJson(value);
    else delete parent[path.at(-1)];
  }

  function manualStatePatches(before, after, kind = 'state') {
    const patches = [];
    const push = path => {
      if (!manualPatchAllowed(path)) return;
      const a=manualValue(before,path), b=manualValue(after,path);
      if (a.exists===b.exists && JSON.stringify(a.value)===JSON.stringify(b.value)) return;
      const patch={path,before_exists:a.exists,after_exists:b.exists,...(a.exists?{before:a.value}:{}),...(b.exists?{after:b.value}:{})};
      if (path[0]==='snapshot' && path[3]==='needs' && b.exists) {
        for (const field of ['elapsed','awake_for']) { delete patch.after?.[field]; delete patch.before?.[field]; }
        const field=path[4]==='sleep'?'wake_at':'last_at';
        const now=timelineToHours(after.snapshot?.timeline), anchor=storyAnchorToHours(b.value?.[field]);
        if (now!==null && anchor!==null) patch.anchor_offset={field,hours:now-anchor};
      }
      if (path[0]==='snapshot' && path[4]==='conception' && path.length===6) {
        const window=before.snapshot?.characters?.[path[2]]?.reproductive?.conception;
        patch.window={id:window?.window_id,start:window?.window_started_at};
      }
      patches.push(patch);
    };
    const names=new Set([...Object.keys(before.snapshot?.characters||{}),...Object.keys(after.snapshot?.characters||{})]);
    const changedPregnancies = new Set(['pregnancy-end', 'pregnancy-correct'].includes(kind)
      ? [...names].filter(name => JSON.stringify(before.snapshot?.characters?.[name]?.reproductive?.pregnancy)
        !== JSON.stringify(after.snapshot?.characters?.[name]?.reproductive?.pregnancy))
      : []);
    for (const name of names) {
      const a=before.snapshot?.characters?.[name], b=after.snapshot?.characters?.[name], root=['snapshot','characters',name];
      if (!a||!b || (kind === 'observation' && a.mode !== b.mode)) { push(root); continue; }
      push([...root,'mode']);
      push([...root,'sex']);
      for(const key of NEED_KEYS) push([...root,'needs',key]);
      for(const key of new Set([...Object.keys(a.effects||{}),...Object.keys(b.effects||{})])) push([...root,'effects',key]);
      if(!isPlainObject(a.reproductive)||!isPlainObject(b.reproductive)) push([...root,'reproductive']);
      else {
        push([...root,'reproductive','menstrual_cycle']);
        for (const moduleName of ['pregnancy', 'conception']) {
          if (!a.reproductive[moduleName] || !b.reproductive[moduleName] || (moduleName === 'pregnancy' && changedPregnancies.has(name))) {
            push([...root, 'reproductive', moduleName]);
          } else {
            for (const field of ['character_awareness', 'user_awareness']) push([...root, 'reproductive', moduleName, field]);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    for(const name of new Set([...Object.keys(before.character_profiles||{}),...Object.keys(after.character_profiles||{})])) {
      for(const field of MANUAL_PROFILE_FIELDS) push(['character_profiles',name,field]);
    }
    for(const key of new Set([...Object.keys(before.effect_dismissals||{}),...Object.keys(after.effect_dismissals||{})])) push(['effect_dismissals',key]);
    for(const name of new Set([...Object.keys(before.stamina_profiles||{}),...Object.keys(after.stamina_profiles||{})])) push(['stamina_profiles',name]);
    for (const name of changedPregnancies) push(['archives',name]);
    for (const [key, entry] of Object.entries(before.conception_event_ledger || {})) {
      if (changedPregnancies.has(entry.character)) {
        for (const field of ['closed','resolution','notice_pending']) push(['conception_event_ledger',key,field]);
      }
    }
    for(const key of new Set([...Object.keys(before.conception_decision_ledger||{}),...Object.keys(after.conception_decision_ledger||{})])) {
      if ((before.conception_decision_ledger?.[key]?.manual || after.conception_decision_ledger?.[key]?.manual)
        && JSON.stringify(before.conception_decision_ledger?.[key])!==JSON.stringify(after.conception_decision_ledger?.[key])) {
        push(['conception_decision_ledger',key]);
        const name=after.conception_decision_ledger?.[key]?.character || before.conception_decision_ledger?.[key]?.character;
        if(name && !patches.some(p=>p.path[0]==='archives'&&p.path[1]===name))push(['archives',name]);
      }
    }
    for(const id of new Set([...Object.keys(before.active_conception_decisions||{}),...Object.keys(after.active_conception_decisions||{})])) {
      if (before.conception_decision_ledger?.[before.active_conception_decisions?.[id]]?.manual || after.conception_decision_ledger?.[after.active_conception_decisions?.[id]]?.manual
        || changedPregnancies.has(before.conception_decision_ledger?.[before.active_conception_decisions?.[id]]?.character)) push(['active_conception_decisions',id]);
    }
    return patches;
  }

  function applyManualRow(store, row, direction = 'after', contextOnly = false) {
    const observation = row.kind === 'observation' && direction === 'after' && !contextOnly
      ? row.patches.find(p => p.path[0] === 'character_profiles' && p.path[2] === 'manual_observation' && ['away','enter'].includes(p.after)) : null;
    const name = observation?.path[1];
    const patches=direction==='before'?[...row.patches].reverse():row.patches;
    for(const patch of patches) {
      if (observation && ((patch.path[0] === 'snapshot' && patch.path[2] === name)
        || (patch.path[0] === 'character_profiles' && patch.path[1] === name && ['manual_observation','observation_memory','observation_paused'].includes(patch.path[2])))) continue;
      if(contextOnly && ['snapshot','archives','conception_event_ledger','conception_decision_ledger','active_conception_decisions'].includes(patch.path[0])) continue;
      const exists=patch[`${direction}_exists`]; let value=cloneJson(patch[direction]);
      if(direction==='after' && patch.path[0]==='snapshot') {
        if(!store.snapshot && exists) store.snapshot={version:5,timeline:cloneJson(row.timeline)||null,scene:null,characters:{}};
         
        if(patch.path.length>3 && !store.snapshot?.characters?.[patch.path[2]]) continue;
        if(patch.window) {
          const current=store.snapshot?.characters?.[patch.path[2]]?.reproductive?.conception;
          if(!current || current.window_id!==patch.window.id || current.window_started_at!==patch.window.start) continue;
        }
        if(patch.anchor_offset && isPlainObject(value)) {
          const now=timelineToHours(store.snapshot?.timeline);
          if(now!==null) {
            const anchor=hoursToStoryAnchor(now-patch.anchor_offset.hours);
            if(anchor) value[patch.anchor_offset.field]=anchor;
            else delete value[patch.anchor_offset.field];
          }
        }
      }
      if(direction==='after' && patch.path[0]==='effect_dismissals' && isPlainObject(value)) value.dismissed_at=timelineToStoryAnchor(store.snapshot?.timeline)||value.dismissed_at||null;
      writeManualValue(store,patch.path,exists,value);
      if(direction==='after' && patch.path[0]==='snapshot' && patch.path[4]==='conception' && patch.path.length===6 && exists) {
        const current=store.snapshot?.characters?.[patch.path[2]]?.reproductive?.conception;
        if(current && isPlainObject(store.conception_event_ledger)) setConceptionLedgerAwareness(store.conception_event_ledger,patch.path[2],current,patch.path[5],value);
      }
    }
    if (observation) {
      store.character_profiles ||= {};
      const profile = store.character_profiles[name] ||= {};
      profile.name = name;
      store.snapshot ||= {version:5, timeline:cloneJson(row.timeline) || null, scene:null, characters:{}};
      const modules = modulesWithPlayRequirements(modulesFromStore(store,'vnext'),playNarrativeRouteIds(store.active_play_routes || [],store.snapshot));
      const seed = row.patches.find(p => p.path.length === 3 && p.path[0] === 'snapshot' && p.path[2] === name)?.after;
      applyObservationChoice(store.snapshot, profile, observation.after, modules, store.archives?.[name], seed);
      store.sexual_desire_profiles = observationDesireProfiles(store, name, observation.after, store.snapshot, modules);
    }
    if(store.snapshot?.characters && !Object.keys(store.snapshot.characters).length && store.snapshot.scene===null) store.snapshot=null;
    return store;
  }

  function manualReplayContext(store) {
    const context={snapshot:null,character_profiles:cloneJson(store?.character_profiles||{}),effect_dismissals:cloneJson(store?.effect_dismissals||{})};
    for(const row of manualHistory(store).reverse()) applyManualRow(context,row,'before',true);
     
    for(const profile of Object.values(context.character_profiles)) if(profile.active===undefined) profile.active=false;
    return context;
  }

  function manualRowsAt(store, messages, first=-1, last=Infinity, branchIndex=null) {
    const rows=manualHistory(store);
    if(!rows.length) return [];
    const index=branchIndex||manualBranchIndex(messages);
    return rows.filter(row=>manualRowActive(row,index,last) && (row.anchor?.message_id??-1)>first)
      .sort((a,b)=>(a.anchor?.message_id??-1)-(b.anchor?.message_id??-1)||a.seq-b.seq);
  }

  function normalizeManualProjection(store, previous = store.snapshot) {
    const modules=modulesWithPlayRequirements(modulesFromStore(store,'vnext'),playNarrativeRouteIds(store.active_play_routes||[],store.snapshot));
    const restored = restoreDailyAnchorsIntoSnapshot(store.snapshot, store.daily_anchor_archives, modules, [], store.character_profiles);
    let snapshot = ensureActiveCharacterProfiles(restored, store.character_profiles, modules, previous);
    const prepared=prepareLifeState(snapshot,modules,store.character_profiles,previous);
    if(!prepared.valid) throw new Error(`手动修改后的状态无法恢复：${prepared.errors.join('；')}`);
    snapshot=applyEffectDismissals(prepared.snapshot,store.effect_dismissals).snapshot;
    store.snapshot=reconcileCyclePresence(snapshot,previous,store.cycle_presence_enabled===true,modules);
    store.has_valid_snapshot=store.snapshot!==null;
    store.daily_anchor_archives=updateDailyAnchorArchives(store.daily_anchor_archives,store.snapshot,modules,{}, {pruneMissing:modules.daily_needs.length>0});
    if(modules.reproductive) store.archives=applyArchiveOperations(store.archives,store.archive_tombstones,store.snapshot,[],{source_message_id:store.source_message_id,source_swipe_id:store.source_swipe_id}).archives;
    const manualNotices=Object.values(sanitizeConceptionDecisionLedger(store.conception_decision_ledger)).filter(entry=>entry.manual);
    store.conception_event_ledger=reconcileConceptionAwarenessLedger(store.conception_event_ledger||{},store.snapshot,manualNotices);
    return store;
  }

  function manualCanonicalStore(store) {
    const clean={...cloneJson(store)};
    const pending=store?.manual_pending_base;
    if(pending && pending.source_message_id===(store.source_message_id??null)) {
      for(const field of MANUAL_CALC_FIELDS) if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(pending,field)) clean[field]=cloneJson(pending[field]);
      const future=manualHistory(store).filter(row=>(row.anchor?.message_id??-1)>(store.source_message_id??-1));
      for(const row of future.reverse()) applyManualRow(clean,row,'before',true);
    }
    delete clean.manual_pending_base;
    clean.has_valid_snapshot=clean.snapshot!==null && clean.snapshot!==undefined;
    return clean;
  }

  function projectPendingManualEdits(store, messages) {
    if(!manualHistory(store).length) return store;
    const next=cloneJson(store); delete next.manual_pending_base;
    const source=store.source_message_id??-1;
    const rows=manualRowsAt(store,messages,source);
    if(rows.length) {
      if(sanitizeExternalPendingQueue(store.external_pending_queue).length) next.manual_pending_base={source_message_id:store.source_message_id??null,...Object.fromEntries(MANUAL_CALC_FIELDS.map(key=>[key,cloneJson(store[key]??null)]))};
      for(const row of rows) applyManualRow(next,row);
      normalizeManualProjection(next,store.snapshot);
    }
    next.manual_projection_key=manualProjectionKey(next,messages);
    return next;
  }

  async function commitManualStateStore(adapter, base, next, kind='state', expectedIdentity='') {
    const identity=expectedIdentity||operationChatIdentity(adapter);
    try {
    if(!adapter?.getStore || !adapter?.setStore) throw new Error('缺少可靠的状态读取或保存接口，修改尚未保存。');
    const patches=manualStatePatches(base,next,kind);
    if(patches.length && runtime.generationActive) throw new Error('保存时正文仍在生成，修改尚未保存；本轮结束后可重试，填写内容已保留。');
    const messages=adapter.listMessages?await adapter.listMessages():[];
    if(!Array.isArray(messages)) throw new Error('无法读取当前聊天分支，修改尚未保存，请刷新后重试。');
    const index=manualBranchIndex(messages), anchor=[...index.values()].at(-1)||null;
    if(!anchor && Number.isInteger(base.source_message_id) && !adapter.listMessages) throw new Error('无法定位当前楼层，请刷新后再修改。');
    assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter,identity);
    if(adapter.getStore && JSON.stringify(await adapter.getStore()||{})!==JSON.stringify(base)) throw new Error('状态刚刚发生变化，修改尚未保存，请刷新后重试。');
    const commit={...next};
    if(patches.length) {
      const rows=manualHistory(base),seq=Math.max(0,...rows.map(row=>row.seq))+1;
      commit.manual_state_edits=[...rows,{seq,kind,anchor,timeline:cloneJson(next.snapshot?.timeline)||null,patches}];
       
      commit.external_manual_effect_edits=base.external_manual_effect_edits||[];
      if((sanitizeExternalPendingQueue(base.external_pending_queue).length || normalizeWorkflowMode(base.state_workflow_mode)===WORKFLOW_MODES.EXTERNAL)
        && (anchor?.message_id??-1)>(base.source_message_id??-1)) {
        commit.manual_pending_base=base.manual_pending_base||{source_message_id:base.source_message_id??null,...Object.fromEntries(MANUAL_CALC_FIELDS.map(key=>[key,cloneJson(base[key]??null)]))};
      }
      commit.manual_projection_key=manualProjectionKey(commit,messages);
    }
    if(adapter.listMessages && JSON.stringify([...manualBranchIndex(await adapter.listMessages()).values()])!==JSON.stringify([...index.values()])) throw new Error('聊天分支已变化，修改尚未保存，请重试。');
    assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter,identity);
    await adapter.setStore(commit,identity);
    assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter,identity);
    setManualSaveNotice('',adapter,identity);
    return commit;
    } catch(error) {
      const message=String(error?.message||'');
      setManualSaveNotice(/尚未保存|正文正在生成|分支已变化/.test(message)?message:'本次修改未保存，填写内容已保留，请稍后重试。',adapter,identity);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  function setManualSaveNotice(message,adapter=runtime.adapter,identity='') {
    if(identity && operationChatIdentity(adapter)!==identity) return;
    runtime.manualSaveError=message;
    const notice=(runtime.hostDocument||getHostDocument())?.getElementById(CONFIG.panelId)?.querySelector('.ls-manual-save-notice');

  async function setWorkflowMode(mode, adapter = runtime.adapter, options = {}) {
    if (runtime.externalBackgroundJob && !options.discardExternalPending) throw new Error('后台分析正在进行；可稍后切换，或选择“停止外接并切回内置”。');
    cancelInlineFormatRepair();
    if (!adapter?.setStore) throw new Error('没有可用的聊天变量持久化接口');
    const next = normalizeWorkflowMode(mode);
    const discardPending = options.discardExternalPending === true && next === WORKFLOW_MODES.INLINE;
    if (runtime.externalControl.stopping && !discardPending) return runtime.workflowMode;
    if (runtime.generationActive) {
      runtime.requestedWorkflowMode = next;
      runtime.externalError = '本轮完成后切换。';
      refreshStatePanel();
      return runtime.workflowMode;
    }
    const expectedChatIdentity = operationChatIdentity(adapter);
    let current = adapter?.getStore ? await Promise.resolve(adapter.getStore()) : undefined;
    const previousMode = normalizeWorkflowMode(current?.state_workflow_mode);
    if (next === WORKFLOW_MODES.EXTERNAL && normalizeExternalAnalysisMode(current?.external_analysis_mode) === 'independent'
      && !independentCleaningReady(current)) {
      await beginIndependentSetup(adapter);
      return runtime.workflowMode;
    }
    if (previousMode === WORKFLOW_MODES.EXTERNAL && next !== previousMode && !discardPending) {
      const settled = await flushExternalPending(adapter);
      if (!settled.ok) throw new Error('待更新正文还未结算成功，已保留外接模式；可重试，或选择“停止外接并切回内置”。');
      current = await adapter.getStore();
    }
    assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter, expectedChatIdentity);
    const base = isPlainObject(current) ? current : {};
    const storeSource = adapter?.getStoreSource?.() || 'none';
    const modules = isPlainObject(base.modules) || String(storeSource).startsWith('legacy')
      ? modulesFromStore(base, storeSource)
      : { ...MODULE_DEFAULTS };
    const activePlayIds = normalizeActivePlayIds(base.active_play_routes);
    const effectiveModules = modulesWithPlayRequirements(modules, activePlayIds);
    const externalPendingQueue = discardPending ? [] : sanitizeExternalPendingQueue(base.external_pending_queue);
    const messages = adapter.listMessages ? await adapter.listMessages() : [];
    const skipped = discardPending ? messages.filter(item => item.role === 'assistant'
      && (Number(item.message_id) > Number(base.source_message_id ?? -1)
        || sanitizeExternalPendingQueue(base.external_pending_queue).some(entry => externalMessageMatches(item, entry)))) : [];
    assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter, expectedChatIdentity);
    await adapter.setStore({
      ...base,
      store_version: 5,
      state_workflow_mode: next,
      external_independent_ranges: updateIndependentRanges(base, messages.filter(item => item.role === 'assistant').at(-1)?.message_id ?? -1,
        next === WORKFLOW_MODES.EXTERNAL && normalizeExternalAnalysisMode(base.external_analysis_mode) === 'independent'),
      modules,
      cycle_enabled: effectiveModules.reproductive,
      external_pending_queue: externalPendingQueue,
      ...(discardPending ? {
        manual_pending_base: null,
        external_start_after: messages.filter(item => item.role === 'assistant').at(-1)?.message_id ?? -1,
        external_skipped_turns: [...sanitizeExternalSkippedTurns(base.external_skipped_turns).map(externalMessageIdentity), ...skipped.map(externalMessageIdentity)].slice(-EXTERNAL_LEDGER_LIMIT),
      } : {}),
      ...(next === WORKFLOW_MODES.EXTERNAL && previousMode !== next
        ? { external_start_after: messages.filter(item => item.role === 'assistant').at(-1)?.message_id ?? -1 } : {}),
      saved_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    }, expectedChatIdentity);
    runtime.workflowMode = next;
    restoreExternalSmooth({ ...base, state_workflow_mode: next }, adapter);
    runtime.independentSetup = false;
    await refreshStoryClockContext(adapter, messages);
    runtime.generationMode = null;
    runtime.externalStateLedger = sanitizeExternalStateLedger(base.external_state_ledger);
    runtime.externalUpdateEvery = normalizeExternalUpdateEvery(base.external_update_every);
    runtime.externalBackgroundEnabled = base.external_background_enabled === true;
    runtime.modules = modules;
    runtime.cycleEnabled = effectiveModules.reproductive;
    runtime.externalStatus = 'idle';
    runtime.externalError = '';
    runtime.externalContentFilterNotice = '';
    if (next !== WORKFLOW_MODES.EXTERNAL) runtime.externalResponseOpen = false;
    runtime.externalPreflightResult = null;
    runtime.externalPendingQueue = externalPendingQueue;
    runtime.externalPendingMessageId = externalPendingQueue[0]?.message_id ?? null;
    if (next === WORKFLOW_MODES.EXTERNAL) await ensureExternalPlayLabels(adapter);
    await releasePromptRequest(adapter);
    logStateError('workflow_mode_changed', next === WORKFLOW_MODES.EXTERNAL ? '本聊天已切换为外接工作流。' : '本聊天已切换为内置工作流。', 'info');
    refreshStatePanel();
    return next;
  }

    const currentName = next ? await resolveCurrentUserName(adapter) : previousName;
    if (next && !currentName) throw new Error('无法读取当前用户人格姓名');
    const updated = next && previousName && previousName !== currentName
      ? remapTrackedUserStore(base, previousName, currentName)
      : { ...base };
    await adapter.setStore({
      ...updated,
      store_version: 5,
      user_tracking_enabled: next,
      tracked_user_name: currentName,
      saved_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
    await loadAndRefresh(adapter);
    logStateError('user_tracking_toggled', next ? `User建档已开启：${currentName}` : 'User建档已关闭。', 'info');
    return next;
  }

  async function setAutoProfileEnabled(enabled, adapter = runtime.adapter) {

  function shouldRetryCharacterProfileScan(error) {
    const message = [typeof error === 'string' ? error : error?.message, error?.status, error?.code, error?.error?.message].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    if (/401|403|429|quota|rate.limit|unauthori|forbidden|api.?key|credit|balance|cancel|abort|network|timeout/i.test(message)) return false;
    return / 400 |INVALID_ARGUMENT|json.?schema|response.?schema|response.?format|structured.?output/i.test(message);
  }

  function resetCharacterProfileScan() {
    runtime.independentProfileController?.abort();
    runtime.independentProfileController = null;
    if (runtime.scanReturnView) closeExternalResponse(runtime.hostDocument);
    runtime.characterProfileScanReport = null;
    runtime.characterProfileScanStatus = 'idle';
    runtime.characterProfileScanError = '';
    runtime.characterProfileScanRetrying = false;
    runtime.characterProfileScanActive = false;
  }

  function beginCharacterProfileScan(source) {
    if (runtime.generationActive || runtime.characterProfileScanActive) throw new Error('请等当前任务结束后再扫描。');
    if (runtime.scanReturnView) closeExternalResponse(runtime.hostDocument);
    const report = { source, raw: '', error: '', redacted: false, serialized: false };
    runtime.characterProfileScanReport = report;
    runtime.characterProfileScanStatus = 'scanning';
    runtime.characterProfileScanError = '';
    runtime.characterProfileScanRetrying = false;
    runtime.characterProfileScanActive = true;
    refreshStatePanel();
    return report;
  }

  function scanReportText(value, report) {
    let text = typeof value === 'string' ? value : value == null ? '' : JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
    const key = String(runtime.externalApiConfig?.api_key || '');
    if (key && text.includes(key)) { text = text.split(key).join('[密钥已隐藏]'); report.redacted = true; }
    return text;
  }

  function recordCharacterProfileScan(report, value) {
    if (runtime.characterProfileScanReport !== report) return;
    report.serialized = typeof value !== 'string' && value != null;
    report.raw = scanReportText(value, report);
  }

  function failCharacterProfileScan(report, error) {
    if (runtime.characterProfileScanReport !== report) return;
    report.error = scanReportText(error?.message || String(error), report);
    runtime.characterProfileScanStatus = 'error';
    runtime.characterProfileScanError = report.error;
  }

  async function resolveCharacterProfileScan(input, { report, repair, assertCurrent, controller, timeoutMs, candidate = input }) {
    let failure;
    try { return validateCharacterScanValue(input); } catch (error) { failure = error; }
    if (typeof repair !== 'function') throw failure;
    let facts;
    try { facts = characterScanRepairFacts(candidate); } catch (_) { throw failure; }
    assertCurrent();
    report.repair_status = 'repairing';
    report.validation_error = scanReportText(failure.message, report);
    runtime.characterProfileScanRetrying = false;
    runtime.independentProfileController = controller;
    refreshStatePanel();
    try {
      const payload = { candidate, validation_error: failure.message, schema: CHARACTER_PROFILE_SCAN_SCHEMA.value };
      const returned = await awaitFormatRepair(repair(payload, text => {
        if (runtime.characterProfileScanReport === report && !controller.signal.aborted) report.repair_raw = scanReportText(text, report);
      }), controller.signal, timeoutMs);
      assertCurrent();
      if (!report.repair_raw) report.repair_raw = scanReportText(returned, report);
      const value = typeof returned === 'string' ? EXTERNAL_WORKFLOW.parseJsonResponse(returned) : returned;
      if (value?.repaired !== true) throw new Error('格式修复未完成：' + String(value?.reason || '模型未返回修复结果'));
      const checked = verifyCharacterScanRepair(facts, value.result);
      report.repair_status = 'repaired';
      return checked;
    } catch (error) {
      controller.abort();
      if (runtime.characterProfileScanReport === report) report.repair_status = 'failed';
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async function scanCharacterProfiles(adapter = runtime.adapter, options = {}) {
    if (!adapter?.setStore) throw new Error('没有可用的聊天变量持久化接口');
    if (typeof adapter.readCharacterProfileSource !== 'function' || typeof adapter.generateCharacterProfileScan !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('当前酒馆版本不支持人物扫描');
    }
    const expectedChatIdentity = operationChatIdentity(adapter);
    const compatibility = options.compatibility === true;
    const report = beginCharacterProfileScan(compatibility ? '酒馆兼容扫描' : '酒馆扫描');
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const timeoutMs = EXTERNAL_WORKFLOW.normalizeConfig(runtime.externalApiConfig || loadExternalApiConfig()).timeout_ms;
    const assertCurrent = () => {
      assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter, expectedChatIdentity);
      if (runtime.characterProfileScanReport !== report || controller.signal.aborted) throw new Error('本次人物扫描已停止或失效，请重新扫描。');
    };
    try {
      const source = await Promise.resolve(adapter.readCharacterProfileSource());
      assertCurrent();
      let response;
      try {
        response = await Promise.resolve(adapter.generateCharacterProfileScan(source, compatibility ? { compatibility: true } : undefined));
      } catch (error) {
        assertCurrent();
        if (compatibility || !shouldRetryCharacterProfileScan(error)) throw error;
        runtime.characterProfileScanRetrying = true;
        refreshStatePanel();
        response = await Promise.resolve(adapter.generateCharacterProfileScan(source, { compatibility: true }));
      }
      assertCurrent();
      recordCharacterProfileScan(report, response);
      let current = adapter?.getStore ? await Promise.resolve(adapter.getStore()) : undefined;
      assertCurrent();
      response = await resolveCharacterProfileScan(response, { report, assertCurrent, controller, timeoutMs,
        repair: typeof adapter.generateFormatRepair === 'function' ? payload => adapter.generateFormatRepair(CHARACTER_PROFILE_SCAN_REPAIR_PROMPT, payload) : null });
      assertCurrent();
      if (report.repair_status === 'repaired' && adapter.getStore) { current = await adapter.getStore(); assertCurrent(); }
      const base = isPlainObject(current) ? current : {};
      const profiles = parseCharacterProfileScanResponse(response, base.character_profiles || runtime.characterProfiles);
      await adapter.setStore({
        ...base,
        store_version: 5,
        character_profiles: profiles,
        saved_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      }, expectedChatIdentity);
      assertCurrent();
      runtime.characterProfiles = profiles;
      runtime.characterProfileScanStatus = 'ready';
      logStateError('character_profiles_scanned', `人物扫描完成，共找到 ${Object.keys(profiles).length} 人。`, 'info');
      return profiles;
    } catch (error) {
      if (runtime.characterProfileScanReport === report) {
        if (operationChatIdentity(adapter) !== expectedChatIdentity) resetCharacterProfileScan();
        else failCharacterProfileScan(report, error);
      }
      throw error;
    } finally {
      if (runtime.characterProfileScanReport === report) {
        if (runtime.independentProfileController === controller) runtime.independentProfileController = null;
        runtime.characterProfileScanActive = false;
        runtime.characterProfileScanRetrying = false;
        refreshStatePanel();
      }
    }
  }

   
  function applyObservationChoice(snapshot, profile, action, modules, archive, replaySeed = null) {
    const name = profile.name;
    const before = snapshot.characters[name];
    const memory = profile.observation_memory || {};
    if (before) profile.sex = characterSex(before, profile);
    if (action === 'away') {
      profile.manual_observation = action;
      profile.observation_paused = true;
      if (before?.mode === 'detailed' || !profile.observation_memory) {
        profile.observation_memory = {timeline:cloneJson(snapshot.timeline), effects:before?.mode === 'detailed' ? cloneJson(before.effects || {}) : {}};
        delete profile.observation_memory.effects[CYCLE_PRESENCE_KEY];
        if (before?.reproductive?.menstrual_cycle) profile.observation_memory.cycle = cloneJson(before.reproductive.menstrual_cycle);
      }
      const keep = minimalObservation(before, null, modules);
      if (keep) snapshot.characters[name] = keep;
      else delete snapshot.characters[name];
    } else {
      delete profile.observation_paused;
      delete profile.observation_memory;
      profile.manual_observation = action;
      const character = createManualProfileCharacter(modules, profile);
      if (replaySeed?.needs && character.needs) {
        for (const key of modules.daily_needs) {
          if (replaySeed.needs[key]) character.needs[key] = cloneJson(replaySeed.needs[key]);
        }
      }
      character.effects = { ...cloneJson(memory.effects || {}), ...cloneJson(before?.effects || {}) };
      if (modules.reproductive && (archive?.reproductive || before?.reproductive)) {
        character.reproductive = { ...cloneJson(archive?.reproductive || {}), ...cloneJson(before?.reproductive || {}) };
        const rememberedCycle = memory.cycle && !character.reproductive.pregnancy && !character.reproductive.menstrual_cycle;
        if (rememberedCycle) character.reproductive.menstrual_cycle = cloneJson(memory.cycle);
        const cycle = character.reproductive.menstrual_cycle;
        const cycleTime = rememberedCycle ? memory.timeline : archive?.timeline;
        const days = Math.max(0, Math.floor((calculateTimelineDelta(cycleTime, snapshot.timeline) || 0) / 24));
        if (cycle && Number.isInteger(cycle.cycle_day)) {
          cycle.cycle_day = cycleDayFromPeriodAnchor(cycle.last_period_start_at, snapshot.timeline) || ((cycle.cycle_day - 1 + days) % 28) + 1;
          cycle.phase = deriveFixedCyclePhase(cycle.cycle_day);
        }
        if (archive?.reproductive?.pregnancy) advancePregnancyDays(character.reproductive.pregnancy, archive.reproductive.pregnancy, archive.timeline, snapshot.timeline);
      }
      snapshot.characters[name] = character;
    }
  }

  function observationDesireProfiles(store, name, action, snapshot, modules) {
    const profiles = { ...store.sexual_desire_profiles };
    if (!modules.sexual_desire) return profiles;
    if (action === 'away') {
      if (profiles[name]) profiles[name] = { ...profiles[name], active_detailed:false };
    } else {
      const baseline = store.sexual_desire_baselines?.[name] || profiles[name]?.baseline || '常态';
      const cycleDay = snapshot.characters[name]?.reproductive?.menstrual_cycle?.cycle_day;
      profiles[name] = initializeSexualDesireProfile(name, baseline, cycleDay, modules.reproductive, {}, '手动登场:' + (timelineToStoryAnchor(snapshot.timeline) || ''));
    }
    return profiles;
  }

  async function setCharacterObservation(name, action, adapter = runtime.adapter) {
    adapter = guardStateAdapter(adapter);
    const identity = operationChatIdentity(adapter);
    const base = await adapter.getStore();
    assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter, identity);
    if (!isPlainObject(base) || !['away', 'enter'].includes(action)) throw new Error('无法修改当前人物的观察状态。');
    const before = base.snapshot?.characters?.[name];
    const profiles = sanitizeCharacterProfiles(base.character_profiles);
    if (!Object.hasOwn(profiles, name) && !before && !base.archives?.[name] && !base.daily_anchor_archives?.[name]?.observation_paused) throw new Error('当前聊天中没有这个人物。');
    if (!Object.hasOwn(profiles, name)) {
      if (Object.keys(profiles).length >= CHARACTER_PROFILE_LIMIT) throw new Error('人物档案已满，无法保存离场记录。');
      Object.assign(profiles, sanitizeCharacterProfiles({ [name]: { name, sex: characterSex(before, base.archives?.[name]) } }));
    }
    const profile = profiles[name];
    if (!profile || Object.hasOwn(Object.prototype, name)) throw new Error('人物名称无效。');
    if (profile.manual_observation === action || (action === 'enter' && before?.mode === 'detailed' && profile.manual_observation !== 'away')) return base.snapshot;
    if (action === 'away' && !before) throw new Error('人物已不在当前观察中。');
    const modules = modulesWithPlayRequirements(modulesFromStore(base, 'vnext'), playNarrativeRouteIds(base.active_play_routes || [], base.snapshot));
    const memory = profile.observation_memory || {};
    let snapshot = cloneJson(base.snapshot);
    if (!snapshot) {
      const branch = adapter.listMessages ? await adapter.listMessages() : [];
      assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter, identity);
      const clock = resolveStoryClock(base, branch);
      snapshot = {version:5, timeline:cloneJson(clock?.timeline || memory.timeline || base.archives?.[name]?.timeline || null), scene:null, characters:{}};
    }
    applyObservationChoice(snapshot, profile, action, modules, base.archives?.[name]);
    const next = Object.keys(snapshot.characters).length || snapshot.scene ? snapshot : null;
    const saved = await saveLastValidSnapshot(next, adapter, {
      source_message_id:base.source_message_id ?? null, source_swipe_id:base.source_swipe_id ?? null,
    }, {manualBase:base, manualEdit:'observation', expectedChatIdentity:identity, characterProfiles:profiles,
      sexualDesireProfiles:observationDesireProfiles(base, name, action, snapshot, modules)});
    runtime.snapshot = saved;
    runtime.hasSnapshot = true;
    refreshStatePanel();
    return saved;
  }

  async function setCharacterProfileActive(characterName, active, adapter = runtime.adapter, options = {}) {
    if (!adapter?.setStore) throw new Error('没有可用的聊天变量持久化接口');
    const expectedChatIdentity = operationChatIdentity(adapter);
    const current = adapter?.getStore ? await Promise.resolve(adapter.getStore()) : undefined;
    assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter, expectedChatIdentity);
    const base = isPlainObject(current) ? current : {};
    const profiles = sanitizeCharacterProfiles(base.character_profiles || runtime.characterProfiles);
    const name = normalizeCharacterProfileName(characterName);
    if (!profiles[name]) throw new Error('找不到这个扫描人物');
    const manualModules = modulesFromStore(base, adapter?.getStoreSource?.() || 'ver500');
    const activePlayIds = normalizeActivePlayIds(base.active_play_routes || runtime.activePlayIds);
    const effectiveModules = modulesWithPlayRequirements(manualModules, playNarrativeRouteIds(activePlayIds, base.snapshot));
    let snapshot = base.has_valid_snapshot === true ? cloneJson(base.snapshot) : cloneJson(runtime.snapshot);
    const alreadyInSnapshot = isPlainObject(snapshot?.characters?.[name]);
    if (active && !alreadyInSnapshot) {
      profiles[name].sex = normalizeCharacterProfileSex(options.sex ?? profiles[name].sex);
      const selectedStages = sanitizeProfileInitialStages(options.initialStages);
      profiles[name].initial_stages = Object.fromEntries(effectiveModules.daily_needs.map((needKey) => [
        needKey,
        selectedStages[needKey] || '平稳期',
      ]));
      profiles[name].initial_offsets = Object.fromEntries(effectiveModules.daily_needs.map((needKey) => {
        const stage = profiles[name].initial_stages[needKey];
        return [needKey, randomInitialOffset(needKey, stage)];
      }));
      if (profiles[name].sex === 'female') profiles[name].initial_cycle_day = 1 + Math.floor(randomUnit() * 28);
      else delete profiles[name].initial_cycle_day;
    }
    profiles[name].active = Boolean(active);
    delete profiles[name].manual_observation;
    delete profiles[name].observation_memory;
    delete profiles[name].observation_paused;
    const dailyAnchorArchives = sanitizeDailyAnchorArchives(base.daily_anchor_archives || runtime.dailyAnchorArchives);
    const sexualDesireProfiles = sanitizeSexualDesireProfiles(base.sexual_desire_profiles || runtime.sexualDesireProfiles, base.sexual_desire_baselines || runtime.sexualDesireBaselines);
    if (active) {
      snapshot = ensureActiveCharacterProfiles(snapshot, profiles, effectiveModules, snapshot);
    } else if (isPlainObject(snapshot?.characters)) {
      delete snapshot.characters[name];
      delete dailyAnchorArchives[name];
      delete sexualDesireProfiles[name];
      if (Object.keys(snapshot.characters).length === 0 && snapshot.scene === null) snapshot = null;
    }
    const provenance = {
      source_message_id: Number.isInteger(base.source_message_id) ? base.source_message_id : null,
      source_swipe_id: Number.isInteger(base.source_swipe_id) ? base.source_swipe_id : null,
    };
    if (snapshot === null) {
      await saveNoValidSnapshot(adapter, {
        manualEdit: 'profile-active', manualBase: base,
        characterProfiles: profiles,
        dailyAnchorArchives,
        sexualDesireProfiles,
        modules: manualModules,
        activePlayIds,
        strictStoreRead: true,
        expectedChatIdentity,
      });
    } else {
      snapshot = await saveLastValidSnapshot(snapshot, adapter, provenance, {
        manualEdit: 'profile-active', manualBase: base,
        characterProfiles: profiles,
        dailyAnchorArchives,
        sexualDesireProfiles,
        modules: manualModules,
        activePlayIds,
        strictStoreRead: true,
        expectedChatIdentity,
      });
    }
    runtime.characterProfiles = profiles;
    runtime.snapshot = snapshot;
    runtime.hasSnapshot = snapshot !== null;
    runtime.activeCharacter = active ? name : runtime.activeCharacter === name ? null : runtime.activeCharacter;
    logStateError('character_profile_toggled', `${name}${active ? '已手动建档' : '已手动删档'}。`, 'info');
    refreshStatePanel();
    return snapshot;
  }

  async function saveCharacterProfileSettings(characterName, adapter = runtime.adapter, options = {}) {
    if (!adapter?.setStore) throw new Error('没有可用的聊天变量持久化接口');
    const expectedChatIdentity = operationChatIdentity(adapter);
    const current = adapter?.getStore ? await Promise.resolve(adapter.getStore()) : undefined;
    assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter, expectedChatIdentity);
    const base = isPlainObject(current) ? current : {};
    const name = normalizeCharacterProfileName(characterName);
    const foldedName = name.toLocaleLowerCase();
    if (!name || ['user', '{{user}}', '用户'].includes(foldedName)) throw new Error('请输入有效的人物姓名');

    let profiles = sanitizeCharacterProfiles(base.character_profiles || runtime.characterProfiles);
    const existingName = Object.keys(profiles).find((item) => item.toLocaleLowerCase() === foldedName) || '';
    let snapshot = base.has_valid_snapshot === true ? cloneJson(base.snapshot) : cloneJson(runtime.snapshot);
    const alreadyInSnapshot = isPlainObject(snapshot?.characters?.[name]);
    if (options.create === true && (existingName || alreadyInSnapshot)) throw new Error('这个人物已经存在，可以直接编辑现有档案');

    const profileName = existingName || name;
    const previousProfile = profiles[profileName] || {
      name: profileName,
      sex: characterSex(snapshot?.characters?.[profileName]),
      summary: alreadyInSnapshot ? '当前档案' : '自定义人物',
      wake_start: '07:00',
      wake_end: '09:00',
      active: false,
    };
    const manualModules = modulesFromStore(base, adapter?.getStoreSource?.() || 'ver500');
    const activePlayIds = normalizeActivePlayIds(base.active_play_routes || runtime.activePlayIds);
    const effectiveModules = modulesWithPlayRequirements(manualModules, playNarrativeRouteIds(activePlayIds, snapshot));
    const sex = normalizeCharacterProfileSex(options.sex ?? characterSex(snapshot?.characters?.[profileName], previousProfile));
    const selectedStages = sanitizeProfileInitialStages(options.initialStages);
    const previousStages = sanitizeProfileInitialStages(previousProfile.initial_stages);
    const previousOffsets = sanitizeProfileInitialOffsets(previousProfile.initial_offsets);
    const currentCharacter = snapshot?.characters?.[profileName];
    const paused = previousProfile.manual_observation === 'away';
    const initialStages = { ...previousStages };
    const initialOffsets = { ...previousOffsets };
    const changedNeeds = [];

    for (const needKey of paused ? [] : effectiveModules.daily_needs) {
      const currentStage = NEED_STAGES.has(currentCharacter?.needs?.[needKey]?.stage)
        ? currentCharacter.needs[needKey].stage
        : (previousStages[needKey] || '平稳期');
      const stage = selectedStages[needKey] || currentStage;
      initialStages[needKey] = stage;
      if (!isPlainObject(currentCharacter?.needs?.[needKey]) || currentStage !== stage) {
        initialOffsets[needKey] = randomInitialOffset(needKey, stage);
        changedNeeds.push(needKey);
      }
    }

    profiles[profileName] = {
      ...previousProfile,
      name: profileName,
      sex,
      active: true,
      initial_stages: initialStages,
      initial_offsets: initialOffsets,
    };

    const requestedCycle = options.cycleDay ?? 'keep';
    if (paused && requestedCycle !== 'keep') throw new Error('该人物已手动离场，请先标记登场再调整周期。');
    if(requestedCycle!=='keep' && requestedCycle!=='random' && !(Number.isInteger(Number(requestedCycle)) && Number(requestedCycle)>=1 && Number(requestedCycle)<=28)) throw new Error('周期日应为1至28之间的整数，或选择保持当前／随机。');
    const reproductiveLocked=isPlainObject(currentCharacter?.reproductive?.pregnancy)||isPlainObject(currentCharacter?.reproductive?.conception);
    if((isPlainObject(currentCharacter?.reproductive?.pregnancy) && requestedCycle!=='keep') || (reproductiveLocked && sex === 'male' && characterSex(currentCharacter,previousProfile) !== 'male')) throw new Error('该人物已有孕期或受孕记录，请刷新编辑页；当前生殖记录不能由周期或性别编辑覆盖。');
    if (sex === 'female' && effectiveModules.reproductive) {
      const currentCycleDay = currentCharacter?.reproductive?.menstrual_cycle?.cycle_day;
      const cycleDay = requestedCycle === 'keep' && Number.isInteger(currentCycleDay)
        ? currentCycleDay
        : (Number.isInteger(Number(requestedCycle)) && Number(requestedCycle) >= 1 && Number(requestedCycle) <= 28
          ? Number(requestedCycle)
          : 1 + Math.floor(randomUnit() * 28));
      profiles[profileName].initial_cycle_day = cycleDay;
    } else {
      delete profiles[profileName].initial_cycle_day;
    }

    profiles = sanitizeCharacterProfiles(profiles);
    if (!profiles[profileName]) throw new Error(`人物档案数量不能超过 ${CHARACTER_PROFILE_LIMIT} 个`);
    if (!currentCharacter) delete profiles[profileName].observation_paused;
    snapshot = ensureActiveCharacterProfiles(snapshot, profiles, effectiveModules, snapshot);
    const character = snapshot?.characters?.[profileName];
    if (!isPlainObject(character)) throw new Error('人物档案建立失败');
    character.sex = sex;

    const timelineHours = timelineToHours(snapshot.timeline);
    if (!paused && effectiveModules.daily_needs.length > 0) {
      character.mode = 'detailed';
      if (typeof character.observed_for !== 'number') character.observed_for = 0;
      if (!isPlainObject(character.needs)) character.needs = {};
      for (const needKey of changedNeeds) {
        const need = needSkeleton(needKey, false);
        need.stage = initialStages[needKey];
        const anchor = timelineHours === null ? null : hoursToStoryAnchor(timelineHours - initialOffsets[needKey]);
        if (anchor) {
          if (needKey === 'sleep') need.wake_at = anchor;
          else need.last_at = anchor;
        }
        character.needs[needKey] = need;
      }
    }

    if (sex !== 'female') {
      if (sex === 'male' && options.sex !== undefined && characterSex(currentCharacter,previousProfile) !== 'male') delete character.reproductive;
    } else if (effectiveModules.reproductive && requestedCycle !== 'keep') {
      const cycleDay = profiles[profileName].initial_cycle_day;
      const currentAwareness = currentCharacter?.reproductive?.menstrual_cycle?.user_awareness;
      character.reproductive = {
        menstrual_cycle: {
          cycle_day: cycleDay,
          phase: deriveFixedCyclePhase(cycleDay),
          user_awareness: USER_AWARENESS_VALUES.has(currentAwareness) ? currentAwareness : '未知',
        },
        ...(isPlainObject(currentCharacter?.reproductive?.conception)
          ? { conception: cloneJson(currentCharacter.reproductive.conception) }
          : {}),
      };
    }

    const provenance = {
      source_message_id: Number.isInteger(base.source_message_id) ? base.source_message_id : null,
      source_swipe_id: Number.isInteger(base.source_swipe_id) ? base.source_swipe_id : null,
    };
    snapshot = await saveLastValidSnapshot(snapshot, adapter, provenance, {
      manualEdit: 'profile-settings', manualBase: base,
      staminaProfiles: staminaManualProfiles(base, snapshot, profileName, options.stamina, effectiveModules),
      characterProfiles: profiles,
      modules: manualModules,
      activePlayIds,
      strictStoreRead: true,
      expectedChatIdentity,
    });
    runtime.characterProfiles = profiles;
    runtime.snapshot = snapshot;
    runtime.hasSnapshot = true;
    runtime.activeCharacter = profileName;
    logStateError('character_profile_saved', `${profileName}的档案已保存。`, 'info');
    refreshStatePanel();
    return snapshot;
  }

  async function syncTrackedUserName(adapter = runtime.adapter) {
    if (!runtime.userTrackingEnabled || !adapter?.setStore) return runtime.trackedUserName;
    const currentName = await resolveCurrentUserName(adapter);

  function normalizePlayCombinationDraft(raw) {
    if (!isPlainObject(raw)) return null;
    const kind = ['marking', 'body_modification', 'clamp_pressure', ...NARRATIVE_LIBRARY_PLAY_KINDS].includes(raw.kind) ? raw.kind : '';
    const character = String(raw.character || '').replace(/[
	]+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 120);
    if (!kind || (!character && !(raw.reference_only === true && ['marking', 'body_modification'].includes(kind)))) return null;
    if (kind === 'restraint') return normalizeRestraintDraft(raw);
    if (kind === 'marking') {
      if (raw.layout_version === 3 || raw.marking_route_id) return normalizeMarkingRouteDraft({ ...raw, character });
      const found = findPlayLibraryEntry(MARKING_SELECTABLE_SECTIONS, String(raw.entry_id || ''));
      const carrier = String(raw.carrier || '').replace('纹身(口内墨自褪,留色需重描)', '纹身(口内留色因位置而异)');
      if (!found || !found.entry.carriers.includes(carrier)) return null;
      return {
        kind,
        character,
        layout_version: 2,
        section_id: found.section.id,
        entry_id: found.entry.id,
        carrier,
        detail: sanitizePlayDetail(raw.detail, 500),
        process_pending: markingCarrierKind(carrier) !== 'wearable' && raw.completed !== true && raw.process_pending !== false,
        recovery_enabled: markingCarrierKind(carrier) !== 'wearable' && raw.recovery_enabled === true,
        completed: markingCarrierKind(carrier) !== 'wearable' && raw.completed === true,
      };
    }
    if (kind === 'clamp_pressure') {
      const found = findPlayLibraryEntry(CLAMP_PRESSURE_SELECTABLE_SECTIONS, String(raw.entry_id || ''));
      if (!found) return null;
      const profile = clampPressureEntryProfile(found.entry);
      const location = String(raw.location || '');
      if (profile.locations.length > 0 && !profile.locations.includes(location)) return null;
      const option = profile.options.some((choice) => choice.label === raw.option)
        ? String(raw.option) : profile.defaultOption;
      if (profile.options.length > 0 && !option) return null;
      const clamp = profile.requiresClamp
        ? CLAMP_PRESSURE_BASE_ENTRIES.find((entry) => entry.id === raw.clamp_entry_id) || null
        : null;
      if (profile.requiresClamp && !clamp) return null;
      const pendantVariant = profile.pendantVariants.includes(String(raw.pendant_variant || ''))
        ? String(raw.pendant_variant) : (profile.pendant ? '砝码坠' : '');
      const weight = pendantVariant === '砝码坠' && profile.weights.some((choice) => choice.label === raw.weight)
        ? String(raw.weight) : (pendantVariant === '砝码坠' ? profile.defaultWeight : '');
      const detail = sanitizePlayDetail(raw.detail, 500);
      if (profile.requiresEndpoints && !detail) return null;
      if (found.entry.label === '拴链双夹' && location.includes('另一夹点') && !detail) return null;
      return {
        kind,
        character,
        layout_version: 1,
        section_id: found.section.id,
        entry_id: found.entry.id,
        location,
        option,
        clamp_entry_id: clamp?.id || '',
        pendant_variant: pendantVariant,
        weight,
        detail,
      };
    }
    if (NARRATIVE_LIBRARY_PLAY_KINDS.includes(kind)) {
      const library = narrativeOnlyPlayLibrary(kind);
      const entry = library.entries.find((candidate) => candidate.id === raw.entry_id) || null;
      if (!entry) return null;
      const variant = entry.variants.find((candidate) => candidate.id === raw.variant_id)
        || entry.variants[0]
        || null;
      return {
        kind,
        character,
        layout_version: 1,
        entry_id: entry.id,
        variant_id: variant?.id || '',
        ...(entry.connection ? { connection_detail: sanitizePlayDetail(raw.connection_detail, 500) } : {}),
        detail: sanitizePlayDetail(raw.detail, 500),
      };
    }
    return normalizeBodyRouteDraft(raw);
  }

  async function applyPlayCombination(raw, adapter = runtime.adapter, editingId = '') {
    adapter = guardStateAdapter(adapter);
    if (!adapter?.setStore) throw new Error('没有可用的聊天变量持久化接口');
    const applicationIdentity = operationChatIdentity(adapter);
    const draft = normalizePlayCombinationDraft(raw);
    if (!draft) throw new Error('请完整选择应用角色和玩法搭配');
    const current = adapter?.getStore ? await adapter.getStore() : undefined;
    const base = isPlainObject(current) ? current : {};
    assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter, applicationIdentity);
    if (editingId && draft.reference_only) throw new Error('修改搭配时请选择应用角色。');
    if (draft.reference_only === true) {
      const combinations = sanitizePlayCombinations(base.play_combinations || runtime.playCombinations).map(item => ({ ...item }));
      const next = { id: playCombinationId(), ...draft, active: true, completed: false };
      combinations.push(next);
      await commitManualPlayChange(adapter, base, { play_library_enabled: true, play_combinations: sanitizePlayCombinations(combinations), format_boost_pending: true }, () => {
        runtime.playDraft = null; runtime.playEditingId = '';
        runtime.playFeedback = '已启用本次参考，未指定角色，不建立身体记录。';
        appendPlayInputDraft(next, runtime.hostDocument, adapter, false);
      });
      return cloneJson(next);
    }
    const snapshot = cloneJson(base.has_valid_snapshot === true ? base.snapshot : runtime.snapshot);
    if (!isPlainObject(snapshot?.characters?.[draft.character]) || snapshot.characters[draft.character].mode !== 'detailed') {
      throw new Error('应用角色需要处于当前情景并已建立详细记录');
    }
    const combinations = sanitizePlayCombinations(base.play_combinations || runtime.playCombinations).map((item) => ({ ...item }));
    if (editingId && combinations.some(item => item.id === editingId && item.kind === 'body_modification' && !bodyRouteFor(item))) throw new Error('旧搭配只保留已有记录，请在状态页更新或结束记录；新预设请另选。');
    const previousBody = draft.kind === 'body_modification' && draft.transition_from_id
      ? combinations.find(item => item.id === draft.transition_from_id && item.character === draft.character && item.entry_id === draft.entry_id && bodyRouteFor(item)) : null;
    if (draft.transition_from_id && !previousBody) throw new Error('原搭配已经变化，请重新选择调整对象。');
    if (draft.kind === 'body_modification' && draft.layout_version !== 3 && bodyRouteOverlap(snapshot, combinations, draft, editingId).length && !previousBody && raw.confirm_separate !== true) throw new Error(__lifeStateTextPool[395]);
    const existingIndex = editingId ? combinations.findIndex((item) => item.id === editingId && item.active !== false) : -1;
    if (editingId && (existingIndex < 0 || combinations[existingIndex].kind !== draft.kind)) throw new Error('原搭配已变化，请返回当前搭配重新选择。');
    if (editingId && draft.kind === 'marking' && playCombinationIsCompleted(combinations[existingIndex], snapshot)) throw new Error('标记已经建立，请在状态页维护。');
    const id = existingIndex >= 0 ? combinations[existingIndex].id : playCombinationId();
    const nextCombination = { id, ...draft, active: true };
    const previousCombination = existingIndex >= 0 ? combinations[existingIndex] : null;
    if (previousCombination && draft.kind === 'marking' && draft.layout_version === 3) {
      nextCombination.reference_enabled = previousCombination.reference_enabled !== false;
      nextCombination.reaction_enabled = previousCombination.reaction_enabled !== false;
    }
    const previousHasEffects = previousCombination && Object.values(snapshot.characters).some(person => Object.keys(person.effects || {})
      .some((effectKey) => playEffectParts(effectKey)?.id === previousCombination.id));
    if (previousHasEffects && nextCombination.kind === 'body_modification'
      && (previousCombination.body_route_id !== nextCombination.body_route_id || previousCombination.detail !== nextCombination.detail)) throw new Error('已有记录的搭配不自动换成新预设；请先在状态页处理当前记录，或明确另建一套。');
    if (previousHasEffects && (previousCombination.character !== nextCombination.character
      || previousCombination.kind !== nextCombination.kind
      || previousCombination.entry_id !== nextCombination.entry_id
      || (nextCombination.kind === 'restraint' && previousCombination.partner_character !== nextCombination.partner_character))) {
      throw new Error('已经建立状态的搭配不能更换角色或条目；请另建一套');
    }
    if (existingIndex >= 0) combinations[existingIndex] = nextCombination;
    else combinations.push(nextCombination);
    if (nextCombination.kind === 'marking' && nextCombination.layout_version === 3) {
      const next = deactivateMarkingRouteSiblings(combinations, nextCombination);
      combinations.splice(0, combinations.length, ...next);
    }

    const selection = playCombinationSelection(nextCombination);
    if (!selection) throw new Error('玩法搭配已经失效，请重新选择');
    const dismissals = sanitizeEffectDismissals(base.effect_dismissals || runtime.effectDismissals);
    const character = snapshot.characters[nextCombination.character];
    if (!selection.narrativeOnly && !isPlainObject(character.effects)) character.effects = {};
    for (const descriptor of playCombinationEffectDescriptors(nextCombination)) {
      delete dismissals[effectDismissalId(descriptor.character || nextCombination.character, descriptor.key)];
    }

    const sanitized = sanitizePlayCombinations(combinations);
    assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter, applicationIdentity);
    await commitManualPlayChange(adapter, base, {
      play_library_enabled: true,
      has_valid_snapshot: true,
      snapshot,
      play_combinations: sanitized,
      effect_dismissals: dismissals,
      format_boost_pending: true,

  async function completePlayCombination(id, adapter = runtime.adapter) {
    adapter = guardStateAdapter(adapter);
    if (!adapter?.setStore) throw new Error('没有可用的聊天变量持久化接口');
    const completionIdentity = operationChatIdentity(adapter);
    const current = adapter?.getStore ? await adapter.getStore() : undefined;
    assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter, completionIdentity);
    const base = isPlainObject(current) ? current : {};
    const snapshot = cloneJson(base.has_valid_snapshot === true ? base.snapshot : runtime.snapshot);
    const combinations = sanitizePlayCombinations(base.play_combinations || runtime.playCombinations).map((item) => ({ ...item }));
    const index = combinations.findIndex((item) => item.id === id && item.active !== false);
    if (index < 0) throw new Error('这套进行中的玩法已经不存在');
    const currentCombination = combinations[index];
    const selection = playCombinationSelection(currentCombination);
    if (currentCombination.kind === 'body_modification' && !bodyRouteFor(currentCombination)) throw new Error('旧记录不重复建档；请编辑当前记录。');
    if (playCombinationIsCompleted(currentCombination, snapshot)) throw new Error('已经完成的搭配不重复建档；请编辑当前记录。');
    const canComplete = (currentCombination.layout_version === 2 || currentCombination.layout_version === 3)
      && ((currentCombination.kind === 'marking' && !selection?.wearable) || currentCombination.kind === 'body_modification');
    if (!canComplete) throw new Error('这套玩法不需要手动建立完成状态');
    if (!isPlainObject(snapshot?.characters?.[currentCombination.character])) throw new Error('应用角色当前没有可用档案');
    if (currentCombination.kind === 'marking' && currentCombination.layout_version === 3
      && !markingRouteBaseLayerIsValid(currentCombination, snapshot, combinations)) {
      throw new Error('底层旧标记已经不存在；请先补充真实旧标记，再完成覆印建档。');
    }
    let completed = { ...currentCombination, completed: true, process_pending: false };
    const completedMarkingRoute = markingRouteFor(completed);
    if (completedMarkingRoute?.special === 'progressive_record' && completedMarkingRoute.drafts[1]) {
      completed = { ...completed, draft_id: completedMarkingRoute.drafts[1].id };
    }
    combinations[index] = completed;
    const descriptors = playCombinationEffectDescriptors(completed);
    if (descriptors.length === 0) throw new Error('当前设置没有可建立的完成状态');
    const character = snapshot.characters[completed.character];
    if (!isPlainObject(character.effects)) character.effects = {};
    const dismissals = sanitizeEffectDismissals(base.effect_dismissals || runtime.effectDismissals);
    if (completed.kind === 'body_modification' && completed.transition_from_id) {
      const previous = combinations.find(item => item.id === completed.transition_from_id && item.character === completed.character && item.entry_id === completed.entry_id && bodyRouteFor(item));
      if (!previous || !effectIsPersisting(character.effects[playEffectKey(previous, 'base')])) throw new Error('原搭配记录已经结束，请重新核对本次安排。');
       
       
      const baseDescriptor = descriptors.find(item => item.phase === 'base');
      if (baseDescriptor) character.effects[baseDescriptor.key] = cloneJson(character.effects[playEffectKey(previous, 'base')]);
      delete character.effects[playEffectKey(previous, 'base')];
      delete character.effects[playEffectKey(previous, 'jewelry')];
      previous.active = false;
    }
    for (const descriptor of descriptors) {
      if (descriptor.optional && !descriptor.note) continue;
      if (completed.transition_from_id && descriptor.phase === 'base' && character.effects[descriptor.key]) continue;
      if (descriptor.phase === 'reaction' && effectIsPersisting(character.effects[descriptor.key])) continue;
      character.effects[descriptor.key] = { notes: descriptor.note };
      delete dismissals[effectDismissalId(completed.character, descriptor.key)];
    }
    const sanitized = sanitizePlayCombinations(combinations);
    assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter, completionIdentity);
    await commitManualPlayChange(adapter, base, {
      play_library_enabled: true,
      has_valid_snapshot: true,
      snapshot,
      play_combinations: sanitized,
      effect_dismissals: dismissals,
      format_boost_pending: true,
    }, () => {
      runtime.playFeedback = `已完成并建立${completed.character}的状态：${selection.label}`;
      logStateError('play_combination_completed', runtime.playFeedback, 'info');
    });
    return cloneJson(completed);
  }

  function isEditableBodyModificationEffect(effectKey) {
    return playEffectParts(effectKey)?.prefix === 'body_mod';
  }

  function isEditableMarkingEffect(effectKey, combinations = runtime.playCombinations) {
    const parts = playEffectParts(effectKey);
    if (parts?.prefix !== 'marking' || parts.phase === 'process') return false;
    const combination = playCombinationForEffect(effectKey, combinations);
    const selection = playCombinationSelection(combination);
    return [2, 3].includes(combination?.layout_version) && Boolean(selection);
  }

  function isEditableClampPressureEffect(effectKey, combinations = runtime.playCombinations) {
    const parts = playEffectParts(effectKey);
    if (parts?.prefix !== 'clamp' || parts.phase !== 'state') return false;
    const combination = playCombinationForEffect(effectKey, combinations);
    return combination?.kind === 'clamp_pressure' && Boolean(playCombinationSelection(combination));
  }

  function isEditablePendingToolEffect(effectKey, combinations = runtime.playCombinations) {
    const parts = playEffectParts(effectKey);
    if (!['insertion', 'mouth', 'restraint'].includes(parts?.prefix) || parts.phase !== 'state') return false;
    const combination = playCombinationForEffect(effectKey, combinations);
    return combinationUsesPendingEffect(combination);
  }

  function isEditablePlayEffect(effectKey, combinations = runtime.playCombinations) {
    if (effectKey === CYCLE_PRESENCE_KEY) return false;
    return (EFFECT_ID_RE.test(effectKey) && !isPresetEffectKey(effectKey))
      || effectKey === 'striking_aftereffects'
      || isEditableBodyModificationEffect(effectKey, combinations)
      || isEditableMarkingEffect(effectKey, combinations)
      || isEditableClampPressureEffect(effectKey, combinations)
      || isEditablePendingToolEffect(effectKey, combinations);
  }

  function sanitizePregnancyAwarenessEdits(input) {
     
    const edits = {};
    for (const entry of Object.values(isPlainObject(input) ? input : {})) {
      if (!isPlainObject(entry) || typeof entry.character !== 'string' || !entry.character.trim()) continue;
      if (!['character_awareness', 'user_awareness'].includes(entry.field) || !USER_AWARENESS_VALUES.has(entry.value)) continue;
      if (!Number.isInteger(entry.source_message_id) || entry.source_message_id < 0) continue;
      if (typeof entry.content_sha256 !== 'string' || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(entry.content_sha256)) continue;
      const kind = entry.kind || 'pregnancy';
      if (!['conception', 'pregnancy'].includes(kind)) continue;
      if (kind === 'conception' && (!Number.isInteger(entry.window_id) || entry.window_id < 1
        || typeof entry.window_started_at !== 'string' || !STORY_ANCHOR_RE.test(entry.window_started_at))) continue;
      const record = {
        character: entry.character, kind, field: entry.field, value: entry.value,
        ...(kind === 'conception' ? { window_id: entry.window_id, window_started_at: entry.window_started_at } : {}),
        source_message_id: entry.source_message_id,
        source_swipe_id: Number.isInteger(entry.source_swipe_id) ? entry.source_swipe_id : null,
        content_sha256: entry.content_sha256,
      };
      edits[JSON.stringify([record.character, kind, record.field, record.source_message_id, record.source_swipe_id])] = record;
    }
    return edits;
  }

  function setConceptionLedgerAwareness(ledger, name, conception, field, value) {
    for (const entry of Object.values(ledger)) {
      if (entry.character !== name || entry.window_id !== conception.window_id
        || entry.window_started_at !== conception.window_started_at || entry.closed || entry.actual_outcome) continue;
      if (entry[field] !== value && field === 'character_awareness') entry.notice_pending = value === '已知';
      entry[field] = value;
    }
  }

  function applyPregnancyAwarenessEdits(snapshot, editsInput, message, conceptionLedger = null) {
    const value = cloneJson(snapshot);
    if (!message) return value;
    const hash = externalMessageIdentity(message).content_sha256;
    const swipe = Number.isInteger(message.swipe_id) ? message.swipe_id : null;
    for (const edit of Object.values(sanitizePregnancyAwarenessEdits(editsInput))) {
      if (edit.source_message_id !== Number(message.message_id) || edit.source_swipe_id !== swipe || edit.content_sha256 !== hash) continue;
      const state = value?.characters?.[edit.character]?.reproductive?.[edit.kind];
      if (!isPlainObject(state)) continue;
      if (edit.kind === 'conception' && (state.outcome !== '待判定'
        || state.window_id !== edit.window_id || state.window_started_at !== edit.window_started_at)) continue;
      state[edit.field] = edit.value;
      if (edit.kind === 'conception' && conceptionLedger) {
        setConceptionLedgerAwareness(conceptionLedger, edit.character, state, edit.field, edit.value);
      }
    }
    return value;
  }

  async function correctPregnancyManually(characterName, input, adapter = runtime.adapter, expected = '') {
    if (runtime.generationActive || runtime.externalFlushPromise || runtime.externalStatus === 'translating') {
      throw new Error('请等本轮状态处理结束后再纠正孕期');
    }
    const name = String(characterName || '').trim();
    const confirmation = input?.confirmation;
    const rawDays = String(input?.gestationDays ?? '').trim();
    const days = rawDays ? Number(rawDays) : null;

  function restoreExternalSmooth(store, adapter) {
    runtime.externalSmoothEnabled = store?.external_smooth_enabled === true;
    const history = store?.external_smooth_history;
    const active = runtime.externalSmoothEnabled && normalizeWorkflowMode(store?.state_workflow_mode) === WORKFLOW_MODES.EXTERNAL;
    const valid = history?.chat === smoothChatIdentity(adapter) && Number.isSafeInteger(history?.revision) && history.revision >= 0
      && Array.isArray(history.messages) && history.messages.every(row => isPlainObject(row) && Array.isArray(row.shape) && row.shape.length === 4
        && Number.isInteger(row.shape[0]) && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(row.hash));
    if (active && history?.chat === smoothChatIdentity(adapter) && !valid) throw new Error('流畅更新的历史识别记录损坏，未按空记录继续。');
    runtime.externalSmoothHistory = active && valid ? history : null;
    runtime.externalSmoothIndex = new Map((runtime.externalSmoothHistory?.messages || []).map(row => [row.shape[0], row]));
  }

  function smoothContentHash(message) {
    const history = runtime.externalSmoothHistory;
    if (!history || typeof message?.message !== 'string') return null;
    const entry = runtime.externalSmoothIndex.get(Number(message.message_id));
    if (entry && JSON.stringify(entry.shape) === JSON.stringify(smoothMessageShape(message))) return entry.hash;
     
    return sha256Hex(history.revision ? `smooth:${history.revision}:${message.message}` : message.message);
  }

  async function syncExternalSmoothHistory(adapter, messages, invalidateFrom = null, renewGeneration = true) {
    const store = await adapter.getStore() || {};
    restoreExternalSmooth(store, adapter);
    if (!runtime.externalSmoothEnabled || normalizeWorkflowMode(store.state_workflow_mode) !== WORKFLOW_MODES.EXTERNAL) return store;
    const old = runtime.externalSmoothHistory || { chat: smoothChatIdentity(adapter), revision: 0, messages: [] };
    if (!old.chat) throw new Error('无法识别当前聊天，流畅更新未继续。');
    const ordered = [...messages].sort((a,b) => a.message_id - b.message_id);
    let cutoff = invalidateFrom;
    let renew = renewGeneration;
     
    if (cutoff === null && ordered.length < old.messages.length) cutoff = 0;
    if (cutoff === null) for (let i=0;i<old.messages.length;i++) {
      if (JSON.stringify(old.messages[i].shape) !== JSON.stringify(smoothMessageShape(ordered[i]))) {
        const a=old.messages[i].shape, b=smoothMessageShape(ordered[i]);
        cutoff=a[0]; renew=!(a[0]===b[0] && a[2]===b[2] && a[3]===b[3] && a[1]!==b[1]); break;
      }
    }
    const revision = old.revision + (cutoff !== null && renew ? 1 : 0);
    const known = new Map(old.messages.filter(row => cutoff === null || row.shape[0] < cutoff).map(row => [row.shape[0], row]));
    const history = { chat: old.chat, revision, messages: ordered.map(message => {
      const shape = smoothMessageShape(message), entry = known.get(message.message_id);
      return entry && JSON.stringify(entry.shape) === JSON.stringify(shape) ? entry
        : { shape, hash: sha256Hex(revision ? `smooth:${revision}:${message.message}` : message.message) };
    }) };
    if (JSON.stringify(history) === JSON.stringify(store.external_smooth_history)) return store;
    const next = { ...store, external_smooth_history: history };
    await adapter.setStore(next);
    restoreExternalSmooth(next, adapter);
    return next;
  }
