  async function analyzeExternalRange(start, end, adapter = runtime.adapter) {
    if (String(start).trim() === '' || String(end).trim() === '' || !Number.isInteger(Number(start)) || !Number.isInteger(Number(end))
      || Number(start) < 0 || Number(end) < Number(start)) throw new Error('请填写有效的起止楼号，结束楼不能早于起始楼。');
    if (runtime.externalFlushPromise) throw new Error('已有分析正在进行，请等当前任务完成后再选择区间。');
    adapter = guardStateAdapter(adapter);
    const from = Number(start), cutoff = Number(end);
    let task;
    await queueLocalStateTask(async () => {
      if (runtime.externalFlushPromise) throw new Error('已有分析正在进行，请等当前任务完成后再选择区间。');
      const store = await adapter.getStore() || {};
      if (normalizeWorkflowMode(store.state_workflow_mode) !== WORKFLOW_MODES.EXTERNAL) throw new Error('请先切换到外接模式。');
      const messages = completedExternalBranch(await adapter.listMessages());
      if (!messages.some(message => message.role === 'assistant' && message.message_id >= from && message.message_id <= cutoff)) throw new Error('该区间没有已完成的模型回复。');
      const pending = await syncExternalPendingFromBranch(adapter, messages);
      if (pending.some(row => row.message_id < from)) throw new Error(`请从最早待更新的第 ${pending[0].message_id} 楼开始，不能跳过前面的状态。`);
      if (messages.some(message => message.role === 'assistant' && message.message_id >= from && message.message_id <= cutoff
        && message.message_id > (store.source_message_id ?? -1) && !pending.some(row => externalMessageMatches(message, row)))) {
        throw new Error('区间包含未纳入当前外接流程或已主动跳过的楼层，本次不覆盖历史记录。');
      }
      runtime.externalRange = { start: String(from), end: String(cutoff), message: '正在补算所选区间…', error: '' };
      const completedEnd = messages.filter(message => message.role === 'assistant').at(-1)?.message_id ?? -1;
       
      task = flushExternalPending(adapter, { background: true, cutoff: Math.min(cutoff, completedEnd), rangeStart: from });
    });
    const result = await task;
    assertStateOperation(adapter);
    runtime.externalRange.message = result.ok ? `所选区间已完成，本次更新 ${result.processed || 0} 轮。` : '';
    runtime.externalRange.error = result.ok ? '' : (result.error || '更新已停止，已完成的进度保留。');
    refreshStatePanel(); return result;
  }

  function externalAppendSafeStore(store) {
    const value = { ...store };
    for (const key of ['external_pending_queue', 'saved_at', 'manual_projection_key', 'external_smooth_history']) delete value[key];
    return JSON.stringify(value);
  }

  function externalSourceChanged() {
    return Object.assign(new Error('分析依据已变化，旧结果未保存。'), { code: 'external_source_changed' });
  }

  function externalSourceLayout(messages, cutoff) {
    return JSON.stringify(messages.filter(row => row.message_id <= cutoff).map(row =>
      [row.message_id, row.swipe_id ?? null, row.role, row.is_hidden ?? false]));
  }

  function externalSourceKey(messages, cutoff) {
    return JSON.stringify(messages.filter(row => row.message_id <= cutoff).map(row =>
      [{ message_id: row.message_id, swipe_id: row.swipe_id ?? null, content_sha256: sha256Hex(row.message || '') }, row.role, row.is_hidden ?? false]));
  }

   
  function refreshExternalPacket(packet, latest, current) {
    const { base, messages, batch, input, queue, apiKey } = packet;
    const cutoff = batch.at(-1).message_id;
    if (externalAppendSafeStore(current) !== externalAppendSafeStore(base)
      || JSON.stringify(runtime.externalApiConfig || loadExternalApiConfig()) !== apiKey) {
      throw new Error('状态或设置已被修改（含清理规则与连接），本次旧结果未保存，请重新更新');
    }
    if (externalSourceLayout(messages, cutoff) !== externalSourceLayout(latest, cutoff)) {
      throw new Error('分析分支或楼层结构已变化，本次旧结果未保存，请重新更新');
    }
    if (base.external_smooth_enabled === true) {
      const before = base.external_smooth_history, after = current.external_smooth_history;
      if (!before || !after || before.chat !== after.chat || before.revision !== after.revision
        || JSON.stringify(before.messages.filter(row => row.shape[0] <= cutoff)) !== JSON.stringify(after.messages.filter(row => row.shape[0] <= cutoff))) {
        throw new Error('流畅更新的分支身份已变化，旧结果未保存。');
      }
      return packet;  
    }
    if (externalSourceKey(messages, cutoff) === externalSourceKey(latest, cutoff)) return packet;
    const ids = new Set(batch.map(row => row.message_id));
    if (messages.some(row => row.message_id <= cutoff && !ids.has(row.message_id)
      && !externalMessageMatches(latest.find(item => item.message_id === row.message_id), externalMessageIdentity(row)))) throw externalSourceChanged();
    if (manualProjectionKey(base, latest) !== manualProjectionKey(base, messages)) {
      throw new Error('手动修改所属分支已变化，本次旧结果未保存，请重新更新');
    }
    const freshBatch = batch.map(row => latest.find(item => item.message_id === row.message_id));
    const freshQueue = queue.map(row => {
      const message = freshBatch.find(item => item.message_id === row.message_id);
      return message ? { ...row, ...externalMessageIdentity(message) } : row;
    });
    const freshBase = { ...base, external_pending_queue: sanitizeExternalPendingQueue(base.external_pending_queue).map(row => {
      const message = freshBatch.find(item => item.message_id === row.message_id);
      return message ? { ...row, ...externalMessageIdentity(message) } : row;
    }) };
    runtime.externalContentCleaning = normalizeExternalCleaning(base.external_content_cleaning);
    let freshInput;
    try { freshInput = buildExternalBatchInput(freshBase, freshBatch, latest, freshQueue); }
    catch (_) { throw externalSourceChanged(); }  
    if (JSON.stringify(freshInput) !== JSON.stringify(input)) throw externalSourceChanged();
     
    return { ...packet, base: freshBase, batch: freshBatch, messages: latest, queue: freshQueue };
  }

  async function waitForExternalSourceQuiet(adapter, job, packet) {
    const cutoff = packet.batch.at(-1).message_id;
    const layout = externalSourceLayout(packet.messages, cutoff);
    let key = '', quietSince = Date.now();
    const deadline = quietSince + EXTERNAL_SOURCE_WAIT_MS;
    while (Date.now() < deadline) {
      assertStateOperation(adapter);
      if (runtime.externalControl.stopping || runtime.externalBackgroundJob !== job) throw Object.assign(new Error('自动恢复已取消'), { code: 'external_cancelled' });
      const current = await adapter.getStore(), messages = await adapter.listMessages();
      if (externalAppendSafeStore(current || {}) !== externalAppendSafeStore(packet.base)
        || JSON.stringify(runtime.externalApiConfig || loadExternalApiConfig()) !== packet.apiKey) throw new Error('等待期间设置或状态已改变，请手动重新更新。');
      if (externalSourceLayout(messages, cutoff) !== layout) throw new Error('等待期间分支或楼层结构已改变，请手动重新更新。');
      const next = externalSourceKey(messages, cutoff);
      if (next !== key) { key = next; quietSince = Date.now(); }
      const incomplete = runtime.generationActive && (!Number.isInteger(runtime.generationBaseMessageId) || cutoff > runtime.generationBaseMessageId);
      if (!incomplete && Date.now() - quietSince >= EXTERNAL_SOURCE_QUIET_MS) return;
      await new Promise(resolve => root.setTimeout(resolve, 100));
    }
    throw new Error('正文持续变化，自动恢复已暂停；修改完成后请点击“重试更新”。');
  }

  async function waitForSmoothPacket(adapter, job, packet, local) {
    let signature = '', quietSince = Date.now();
    runtime.externalStatus = 'settling'; refreshStatePanel();
    while (true) {
      assertStateOperation(adapter);
      if (runtime.externalControl.stopping || runtime.externalBackgroundJob !== job || job.invalidated) {
        throw Object.assign(new Error('流畅更新等待已取消'), { code: 'external_cancelled' });
      }
      const fresh = await local(async () => {
        const before = await adapter.getStore() || {};
        if (externalAppendSafeStore(before) !== externalAppendSafeStore(packet.base)
          || JSON.stringify(runtime.externalApiConfig || loadExternalApiConfig()) !== packet.apiKey) throw new Error('等待期间状态或设置已改变，请重试更新。');
        const messages = completedExternalBranch(await adapter.listMessages());
        const cutoff = packet.batch.at(-1).message_id;
        if (externalSourceLayout(messages, cutoff) !== externalSourceLayout(packet.messages, cutoff)) throw new Error('等待期间分支或楼层结构已改变，请重试更新。');
        await syncExternalPendingFromBranch(adapter, messages);
        const base = await adapter.getStore() || {};
        if (base.external_smooth_history?.revision !== packet.base.external_smooth_history?.revision) throw new Error('等待期间分支已改变，请重试更新。');
        const queue = sanitizeExternalPendingQueue(base.external_pending_queue).filter(row => job.cutoff == null || row.message_id <= job.cutoff);
        const mode = normalizeExternalAnalysisMode(queue[0]?.turn_context?.external_analysis_mode);
        const boundary = queue.findIndex(row => normalizeExternalAnalysisMode(row.turn_context?.external_analysis_mode) !== mode);
        const batch = queue.slice(0, Math.min(EXTERNAL_BATCH_LIMIT, boundary < 0 ? EXTERNAL_BATCH_LIMIT : boundary))
          .map(row => messages.find(message => externalMessageMatches(message, row)));
        if (!batch.length || batch.some(row => !row)) throw new Error('等待分析的楼层已变化，请重试更新。');
        if (job.rangeStart != null && batch[0].message_id < job.rangeStart) throw new Error('所选区间之前仍有待处理楼层。');
        runtime.externalContentCleaning = normalizeExternalCleaning(base.external_content_cleaning);
        return { ...packet, base, messages, batch, queue, input: buildExternalBatchInput(base, batch, messages, queue) };
      });
      const next = JSON.stringify(fresh.input);
      if (next !== signature) { signature = next; quietSince = Date.now(); }
      packet = fresh;
      job.activeMessages = packet.batch.map(row => row.message_id);
      if (Date.now() - quietSince >= EXTERNAL_SOURCE_QUIET_MS) {
        runtime.externalStatus = 'translating'; refreshStatePanel(); return packet;
      }
       
      await new Promise(resolve => root.setTimeout(resolve, 250));
    }
  }

  function buildExternalBatchInput(base, batch, messages, queue) {
    base=manualCanonicalStore(base);
    const manualIndex=manualHistory(base).length?manualBranchIndex(messages):null;
    const contexts = batch.map((message, index) => ({ ...base, ...(queue[index].turn_context || {}), external_play_labels: base.external_play_labels || {} }));
    const allModules = contexts.map(context => modulesWithPlayRequirements(modulesFromStore(context, 'vnext'), context.active_play_routes || []));
    const modules = { daily_needs: [...new Set(allModules.flatMap(item => item.daily_needs || []))],
      reproductive: allModules.some(item => item.reproductive), sexual_desire: allModules.some(item => item.sexual_desire), ...(allModules.some(item => item.stamina) ? { stamina: true } : {}) };
    const effectsEnabled = contexts.some(context => context.play_library_enabled === true || context.effect_mode === 'open'
      || (context.cycle_presence_enabled === true && modulesFromStore(context, 'vnext').reproductive)
      || context.active_play_routes?.length || context.play_combinations?.length)
      || Object.values(base.snapshot?.characters || {}).some(character => Object.keys(character.effects || {}).length > 0);
    let previous = cloneJson(base.snapshot);
    for (const message of [...batch].reverse()) for (const edit of [...manualEditsForMessage(base, message)].reverse()) previous = applyEffectEdits(previous, edit.edits, 'before');
    let cycleProjection = cloneJson(previous);
    const hasObservationEdits = Object.values(base.character_profiles || {}).some(p => p.manual_observation)
      || manualHistory(base).some(row => row.kind === 'observation');
    const observationView = hasObservationEdits
      ? {modules:base.modules, active_play_routes:base.active_play_routes, archives:cloneJson(base.archives || {}),
        character_profiles:cloneJson(base.character_profiles || {}), snapshot:cloneJson(previous)} : null;
    function hintForTurn(message, previousBoundary) {
      if (!observationView) return '';
      const applyThrough = (start, end) => {
        for (const row of manualRowsAt(base, messages, start, end, manualIndex)) applyManualRow(observationView, row);
      };
      applyThrough(previousBoundary, message.message_id - 1);
      const hint = manualObservationHint(observationView.character_profiles, observationView.snapshot);
      for (const profile of Object.values(observationView.character_profiles)) {
        if (profile.manual_observation === 'enter') delete profile.manual_observation;
      }
      applyThrough(message.message_id - 1, message.message_id);
      return hint;
    }
    return {
      modules, effect_mode: base.effect_mode, play_library_enabled: effectsEnabled,
      ...(contexts.some((context, index) => cyclePresenceActive(context.cycle_presence_enabled, allModules[index])) ? { builtin_cycle_rule: '只在该轮 allowed_effects 包含 cycle_presence 时维护内置周期影响；其他轮不填写。' + buildExternalCyclePresenceRule() } : {}),
      analysis_mode: normalizeExternalAnalysisMode(contexts[0]?.external_analysis_mode),
      user_tracking_enabled: base.user_tracking_enabled, user_name: base.tracked_user_name,

        ? contexts.some(context => context.auto_profile_enabled !== false) : base.auto_profile_enabled !== false,
      previous_state: previous,
      ...(contexts[0]?.external_analysis_mode === 'independent' ? {

      } : {}),
      ...buildExternalSexualDesireContext(base, modules),
      ...staminaContext(base, modules),
      conception_event_ledger: Object.values(sanitizeConceptionEventLedger(base.conception_event_ledger)),
      state_schema: buildExternalBatchSchema(modules, effectsEnabled, batch.length, allModules),
      turns: batch.map((message, index) => {
        const context = contexts[index];
        const saved = { ...runtime };
        let contracts;
        try { useExternalContext(context); contracts = buildExternalEffectContracts(context.active_play_routes, previous, context.effect_dismissals); }
        finally { Object.assign(runtime, saved); }
        const narrative = filterExternalAssistantContent(message.message);
        if (narrative.diagnostics.required_tag_missing) runtime.externalContentFilterNotice = '有待更新正文未命中提取标签';
        const previousBoundary = index ? batch[index - 1].message_id : base.source_message_id ?? -1;
        const hint = hintForTurn(message, previousBoundary);
        const manualBefore=manualTurnPatches(base,messages,index ? batch[index-1].message_id : base.source_message_id??-1,message.message_id-1,manualIndex);
        const manualAfter=manualTurnPatches(base,messages,message.message_id-1,message.message_id,manualIndex);
         
        if (manualBefore.length || !allModules[index].reproductive) cycleProjection = null;
        const cyclePreview = previewExternalCyclePresence(cycleProjection, context.external_analysis_mode === 'independent'

            ? { restore_request: { name: context.pending_restore.name, sex: normalizeCharacterProfileSex(context.archives[context.pending_restore.name].sex), reproductive: cloneJson(context.archives[context.pending_restore.name].reproductive), timeline: context.archives[context.pending_restore.name].timeline || null } } : {}),
          assistant_narrative: narrative.content,
          ...(context.external_analysis_mode === 'independent' ? {
            story_time: parseStoryTime(message.message), character_reference: independentCharacterReference(context.character_profiles),
            judgment_rules: independentJudgmentRules(context, previous),

              .map(({ character, effect_key, dismissed_at }) => ({ character, effect: effect_key, ended_at: dismissed_at })),

          allowed_effects: contracts,
          ...(cyclePresenceActive(context.cycle_presence_enabled, allModules[index]) && Object.keys(cyclePreview?.context.characters || {}).length
            ? { cycle_presence_context: cyclePreview.context } : {}),

          manual_effect_edits_after: manualEditsForMessage(base, message).flatMap(edit => edit.edits).map(item => ({ character: item.character, effect: item.effect, after: item.after })),
        };
      }),
    };
  }

  function externalRequestSignal() {

  async function stopExternalAndSwitchInline(adapter = runtime.adapter) {
    const control = runtime.externalControl;
    if (control.stopPromise) return control.stopPromise;
    if (runtime.generationActive) throw new Error('正文正在生成，请在本轮正文结束后停止外接。');
    const identity = operationChatIdentity(adapter);
    const background = Boolean(runtime.externalBackgroundJob);
    const queued = runtime.queue;
    control.stopping = true;
    runtime.requestedWorkflowMode = null;
    control.controller?.abort();
    runtime.externalCleaningUI.controller?.abort();
    runtime.independentProfileController?.abort();
    const task = (async () => {
       
      await Promise.allSettled([queued, ...control.operations]);
      assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter, identity);
      return setWorkflowMode(WORKFLOW_MODES.INLINE, adapter, { discardExternalPending: true });
    })();
    control.stopPromise = task;
    if (!background) runtime.queue = task.catch(() => {});
    refreshStatePanel();
    try { return await task; }
    finally {
      control.stopping = false;
      control.controller = null;
      control.stopPromise = null;
      refreshStatePanel();
    }
  }

  function externalMessageIdentity(message) {

      swipe_id: Number.isInteger(message?.swipe_id) ? message.swipe_id : null,

    if (Number(message?.message_id) !== identity?.message_id
      || (Number.isInteger(message?.swipe_id) ? message.swipe_id : null) !== identity?.swipe_id) return false;
    const actual = externalMessageIdentity(message);
    return actual.message_id === identity.message_id && actual.swipe_id === identity.swipe_id
      && actual.content_sha256 === identity.content_sha256;

  function buildExternalBatchSchema(modules, effectEnabled, count, turnModules = []) {

      });

    const state = envelope.properties.state.oneOf[1];

      if (character.properties.reproductive) delete character.properties.reproductive.properties.conception;

      };

    envelope.properties.turn = { type: 'integer', minimum: 1, maximum: count };

  function prepareBatchConceptionState(envelope, previous, store, reserved, messages, turn) {

      update.revisions = (raw.revisions || []).map(revision => {
        if (revision.turn == null) return revision;
        if (!Number.isInteger(revision.turn) || revision.turn >= turn || revision.turn < 1) throw new Error('补救修订只能对应本批已经发生的轮次');

        return { scene_id: event.scene_id, risk_percent: revision.risk_percent };
      });

      if (ids) Object.assign(update, { scene_id: ids.scene_id, window_id: ids.window_id, event_no: ids.event_no });
      const character = envelope.state.characters[update.character];

      if (previous?.characters?.[update.character]?.reproductive?.pregnancy) continue;
      if (!isPlainObject(character.reproductive)) character.reproductive = {};
      const old = previous?.characters?.[update.character]?.reproductive?.conception;
      if (old) character.reproductive.conception = cloneJson(old);
      else if (update.risk_percent > 0 && update.relation !== '补救修订') character.reproductive.conception = {

            const name = shell && !(shell[1] && shell[3]) ? shell[2] : trimmed;
            if (!tagName.test(name)) throw new Error(`${path}：标签名 ${JSON.stringify(item)}${__lifeStateTextPool[398]}`);
            if (/^(life_state|state_handoff|story_time)$/i.test(name)) throw new Error(`${path}：标签名 ${name} 是插件专用标签，不能作为正文清理标签，请重新扫描。`);
            return name.toLowerCase();
          }
          if (key === 'remove_lines_starting_with' && /[
]/.test(item)) throw new Error('整行清理的开头不能包含换行。');
          return item;
        }))];
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(source.remove_blocks) || source.remove_blocks.length > 16) throw new Error('附加块的清理规则不正确。');
      row.remove_blocks = source.remove_blocks.map(block => {
        if (!isPlainObject(block) || ['start', 'end'].some(key => typeof block[key] !== 'string' || !block[key].trim() || block[key].length > 300)) {
          throw new Error('附加块缺少固定的开始或结束标记。');
        }
        return { start: block.start, end: block.end };
      });
      if (!allowConflicts && row.extract_tags.some(tag => row.remove_tags.includes(tag))) throw new Error('同一个标签不能既保留正文又整块屏蔽，请取消其中一项。');
      output[role] = row;
    }
    return output;
  }

  function normalizeExternalCleaning(value) {
    if (!value?.rules) return { enabled: false, rules: null, ...(value?.recommendation_dismissed === true ? { recommendation_dismissed: true } : {}) };
    try {
      const result = { enabled: value.enabled === true, rules: validateExternalCleaningRules(value.rules) };
       
      try { if (value.available_rules) result.available_rules = validateExternalCleaningRules(value.available_rules, true); } catch (_) {   }
      return result;
    }
    catch (_) { return { enabled: false, rules: null }; }
  }

  function externalTagSpans(text, names) {
    const selected = new Set(names);
    const stacks = new Map(names.map(name => [name, []]));
    const spans = [], shells = [];
    const fail = (name, message) => { throw Object.assign(new Error(message), { tag: name }); };
     
    const pattern = /<(/?)([\p{L}_][\p{L}\p{N}_.:\-]*)/gu;
    let match;
    while ((match = pattern.exec(text))) {
      const name = match[2].toLowerCase();
      if (!/[\s/>]/.test(text[pattern.lastIndex] || '')) continue;
      let cursor = pattern.lastIndex, quote = '';
      for (; cursor < text.length; cursor++) {
        const char = text[cursor];
        if (quote) { if (char === quote) quote = ''; }
        else if (char === '"' || char === "'") quote = char;
        else if (char === '>') break;
      }
      if (cursor === text.length) {
        if (selected.has(name)) fail(name, `标签 ${name} 不完整，请取消这条规则或补充说明调整。`);
        break;
      }
      const end = cursor + 1;
      pattern.lastIndex = end;
      if (!selected.has(name)) continue;
      shells.push([match.index, end]);
      const stack = stacks.get(name);
      if (match[1]) {
        const start = stack.pop();
        if (!start) fail(name, `标签 ${name} 缺少开头，请取消这条规则或补充说明调整。`);
        spans.push({ start: start[0], end, innerStart: start[1], innerEnd: match.index });
      } else if (//\s*>$/.test(text.slice(match.index, end))) {
        spans.push({ start: match.index, end, innerStart: end, innerEnd: end });
      } else stack.push([match.index, end]);
    }
    for (const [name, stack] of stacks) if (stack.length) fail(name, `标签 ${name} 没有闭合，请取消这条规则或补充说明调整。`);
    return { spans: spans.sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start || b.end - a.end), shells };
  }

  function removeExternalRanges(text, ranges) {
    let end = 0, output = '';
    for (const [start, stop] of ranges.sort((a, b) => a[0] - b[0] || b[1] - a[1])) {
      if (stop <= end) continue;
      output += text.slice(end, Math.max(end, start));
      end = stop;
    }
    return output + text.slice(end);
  }

  function applyExternalCleaning(text, role, rules) {
    const original = String(text || '');
    const row = rules[role];
    const ids = (key, values = row[key]) => values.map(value => externalCleaningRuleId(role, key, value));
    const tagSpans = (content, key) => {
      try { return externalTagSpans(content, row[key]); }
      catch (error) { throw externalCleaningError(error.message, ids(key, error.tag ? [error.tag] : row[key])); }
    };
    const conflict = row.extract_tags.find(tag => row.remove_tags.includes(tag));
    if (conflict) throw externalCleaningError(`标签 ${conflict} 同时被设为保留正文和整块屏蔽，请取消其中一项。`, [...ids('extract_tags', [conflict]), ...ids('remove_tags', [conflict])]);
    let content = stripExternalContextState(original).replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g, '');
    if (row.extract_tags.length) {
      const { spans } = tagSpans(content, 'extract_tags');
      if (!spans.length) throw externalCleaningError('未找到正文标签，请取消对应提取项或补充说明调整；本次没有发送原文。', ids('extract_tags'));
      let end = -1;
      content = spans.filter(span => {
        if (span.start < end) return false;
        end = span.end; return true;
      }).map(span => content.slice(span.innerStart, span.innerEnd)).join('

');
    }
     
    const removed = tagSpans(content, 'remove_tags');
    const ranges = removed.spans.map(span => [span.start, span.end]);
    for (const block of row.remove_blocks) {
      let start = content.indexOf(block.start);
      while (start >= 0) {
        const end = content.indexOf(block.end, start + block.start.length);
        if (end < 0) throw externalCleaningError(`附加块没有找到结束标记：“${block.start}” → “${block.end}”。可取消这条规则或补充说明调整。`, ids('remove_blocks', [block]));
        ranges.push([start, end + block.end.length]);
        start = content.indexOf(block.start, end + block.end.length);
      }
    }
    content = removeExternalRanges(content, ranges);
    content = removeExternalRanges(content, tagSpans(content, 'unwrap_tags').shells);
    content = content.split('
').filter(line => !row.remove_lines_starting_with.some(prefix => line.trimStart().startsWith(prefix))).join('
');
    for (const literal of row.remove_literals) content = content.split(literal).join('');
    content = content.replace(/
{3,}/g, '

').trim();
    if (role === 'assistant' && !content) throw externalCleaningError('清理后没有正文，请检查勾选项或补充说明调整。', externalCleaningEntries(rules).filter(item => item.role === role).map(item => item.id));
    return { content, diagnostics: { mode: 'chat_rules', role, original_length: original.length, filtered_length: content.length, required_tag_missing: false } };
  }

  function selectExternalCleaningSamples(messages) {
    const ordered = messages.filter(item => ['user', 'assistant'].includes(item?.role) && typeof item.message === 'string')
      .sort((a, b) => Number(a.message_id) - Number(b.message_id));
    const assistants = ordered.filter(item => item.role === 'assistant').slice(-3);
    if (!assistants.length) throw new Error('先生成一段正文，再扫描正文格式。');
    const ids = new Set(assistants.map(item => Number(item.message_id)));
    assistants.forEach(item => { const user = getUserMessageBefore(ordered, item.message_id); if (user) ids.add(Number(user.message_id)); });
    const samples = ordered.filter(item => ids.has(Number(item.message_id))).map(item => ({ message_id: Number(item.message_id), role: item.role, content: stripExternalContextState(item.message) }));
    if (samples.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item.content.length, 0) > 200000) throw new Error('最近三段正文过长，本次未发送。可先使用 API 设置中的手动标签处理。');
    return samples;
  }

  async function scanExternalContent(adapter = runtime.adapter, options = {}) {
    const ui = runtime.externalCleaningUI;
    if (ui.busy || ui.saving) return null;
    if (runtime.generationActive) throw new Error('等本轮正文结束后再扫描。');
    const refining = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(options, 'feedback');
    const feedback = String(options.feedback || '').trim();
    if (refining && (!ui.candidate || !feedback)) throw new Error('请先扫描，再填写想调整的地方。');
    if (feedback.length > 2000) throw new Error('补充说明请控制在 2000 字以内。');
    const identity = operationChatIdentity(adapter);
    const check = () => {
      assertOperationChatUnchanged(adapter, identity);
      if (runtime.externalCleaningUI !== ui || ui.controller?.signal.aborted) throw new Error('扫描已取消。');
    };
    ui.busy = true; ui.open = true; ui.error = ''; ui.message = ''; ui.preview = null;
    ui.controller = new AbortController();
    refreshStatePanel();
    try {
      const samples = refining
        ? ui.samples.map(({ message_id, role, content }) => ({ message_id, role, content }))
        : selectExternalCleaningSamples(await adapter.listMessages());
      check();
      const request = { samples };
      if (refining) Object.assign(request, {
        current_rules: selectedExternalCleaningRules(ui), previous_feedback: ui.history, feedback,
        preview_errors: ui.samples.filter(sample => sample.error).map(({ message_id, role, error }) => ({ message_id, role, error })),
      });
      const result = await EXTERNAL_WORKFLOW.requestJson(runtime.externalApiConfig || loadExternalApiConfig(), [
        { role: 'system', content: EXTERNAL_CONTENT_SCAN_PROMPT + (refining ? `

${EXTERNAL_CONTENT_REFINE_PROMPT}` : '') },
        { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify(request) },
      ], { signal: ui.controller.signal, fetchImpl: options.fetchImpl, traceKind: 'content_scan' });
      check();
      const rules = validateExternalCleaningRules(result.value, true);
       
      if (refining) {
        const existing = new Set(externalCleaningEntries(rules).map(item => item.id));
        for (const item of externalCleaningEntries(ui.candidate)) {
          if (ui.disabled.includes(item.id) && !existing.has(item.id)
            && rules[item.role][item.key].length < (item.key === 'remove_blocks' ? 16 : 32)) rules[item.role][item.key].push(item.value);
        }
      } else ui.disabled = [];
      ui.candidate = rules;
      ui.samples = previewExternalCleaning(samples, selectedExternalCleaningRules(ui));
      const latest = [...samples].reverse().find(sample => sample.role === 'assistant');
      if (latest && !refining) ui.openSamples = [`${latest.role}:${latest.message_id}`];
      ui.history = refining ? [...ui.history, feedback] : [];
      ui.feedback = ''; clearEditorDrafts('cleaning-feedback');
      ui.message = refining ? '已按补充说明调整，请检查勾选项和前后对照，再确认使用。' : '扫描完成，可取消不需要的清理项，也可以补充说明让模型调整。';
      return rules;
    } catch (error) {
      if (runtime.externalCleaningUI === ui) ui.error = error.message || String(error);
      throw error;
    } finally {
      if (runtime.externalCleaningUI === ui) { ui.busy = false; ui.controller = null; refreshStatePanel(); }
    }
  }

  async function saveExternalCleaning(enabled, rules = runtime.externalContentCleaning.rules, adapter = runtime.adapter, options = {}) {
    const ui = runtime.externalCleaningUI;
    if (ui.busy) throw new Error('请等待调整完成或取消本次请求。');
    const identity = operationChatIdentity(adapter);
    const confirmingIndependent = runtime.independentSetup || independentAnalysisActive();
    if (!enabled && independentAnalysisActive()) throw new Error('独立分析需要确认过的正文。无需清理时可预览原文后确认，或先切回协作分析。');
    const next = { enabled: enabled === true, rules: rules ? validateExternalCleaningRules(rules) : null };
    if (options.availableRules) next.available_rules = validateExternalCleaningRules(options.availableRules, true);
    else if (rules === runtime.externalContentCleaning.rules && runtime.externalContentCleaning.available_rules) next.available_rules = cloneJson(runtime.externalContentCleaning.available_rules);
    if (next.enabled && !next.rules) throw new Error('请先扫描并检查清理效果。');

      const preview = previewExternalCleaning(samples, next.rules);
      if (confirmingIndependent && JSON.stringify(samples.map(item => [item.message_id, item.role, item.content]))

    let formatted;
    if (hours === 0) formatted = `${minutes} 分钟`;

    else formatted = `${hours} 小时 ${minutes} 分钟`;
    return `${prefix}${formatted}`;

    }
    if (combination.kind === 'body_modification') {
      const route = bodyRouteFor(combination);
      const matching = route && completed && bodyReferenceMatches(combination, runtime.snapshot);

      const summary = !route ? '旧搭配仅保留已有记录，不注入旧正文' : combination.reference_enabled === false ? '完整参考已关闭，当前记录继续维护' : !completed ? '本次计划，尚未确认完成' : matching ? '完整正文参考已启用' : '参考已暂停，当前记录仍保留';
      const actions = !route ? '' : !completed
        ? `<button type="button" data-action="insert-play-input-draft" data-combination-id="${combination.id}">填入草稿</button><button type="button" data-action="edit-play-combination" data-combination-id="${combination.id}">修改计划</button><button type="button" data-action="complete-play-combination" data-combination-id="${combination.id}">完成并建立状态</button>`
        : !matching && live ? `<details><summary>核对原预设</summary><div>${escapeHtml(route.body)}${__lifeStateTextPool[464]}${combination.id}">确认仍匹配预设</button></details>` : '';
      return `<article class="ls-play-combination-card"><div><strong>${escapeHtml(selection.label)}</strong><small>${escapeHtml(combination.character)}｜${escapeHtml(summary)}</small></div><div class="ls-play-combination-actions">${actions}${playReferenceControl(combination)}<button type="button" data-action="remove-play-combination" data-combination-id="${combination.id}">移除搭配</button></div></article>`;
    }
    if (combination.kind === 'marking' && combination.layout_version !== 3) {
      return `<article class="ls-play-combination-card"><div><strong>${escapeHtml(selection?.label || '旧标记搭配')}</strong><small>${escapeHtml(combination.character)}${__lifeStateTextPool[465]}${combination.id}">停止旧搭配注入</button></div></article>`;
    }
    const manualCompletion = ((combination.kind === 'marking' && combination.layout_version === 3)
      || (combination.kind === 'body_modification' && combination.layout_version === 2)) && !selection?.wearable;
    const pendingDescriptor = pendingStateEffectDescriptor(combination);
    const pendingEffect = pendingDescriptor
      ? runtime.snapshot?.characters?.[combination.character]?.effects?.[pendingDescriptor.key] : null;
    const summary = manualCompletion && !completed
      ? '进行中，完成后建立状态'
      : (pendingDescriptor
      ? (effectIsPersisting(pendingEffect) ? '当前状态已建立' : '本次准备')
      : (selection?.narrativeOnly ? '本次准备'
      : (combination.kind === 'body_modification' && !selection?.legacy
      ? `${bodyModificationEffectDescriptors({ ...combination, completed: true }).length} 项当前状态`
      : (combination.kind === 'marking' && !selection?.legacy ? '当前状态已建立' : '本次准备'))));
    const completeButton = (['restraint', 'marking', 'body_modification'].includes(combination.kind)
      ? `<button type="button" data-action="insert-play-input-draft" data-combination-id="${combination.id}">填入草稿</button>` : '')
      + (manualCompletion && !completed
      ? `<button type="button" data-action="complete-play-combination" data-combination-id="${combination.id}">完成并建立状态</button>` : '');
    const editButton = completed && combination.kind === 'marking' && combination.layout_version === 3
      ? '' : `<button type="button" data-action="edit-play-combination" data-combination-id="${combination.id}">修改</button>`;
    return `<article class="ls-play-combination-card"><div><strong>${escapeHtml(selection?.label || '玩法搭配')}</strong><small>${escapeHtml(combination.character)}｜${escapeHtml(summary)}</small></div><div class="ls-play-combination-actions">${completeButton}${editButton}${playReferenceControl(combination)}<button type="button" data-action="remove-play-combination" data-combination-id="${combination.id}">移除搭配</button></div></article>`;

  function insertTextIntoChatInput(text, document = runtime.hostDocument || getHostDocument()) {
    const input = findChatInput(document);

    const value = input.value;
    if (value.includes(text.match(/\[item:[^\]]+\]/i)?.[0] || text)) {
      input.focus?.();
      return 'exists';
    }
    const start = Number.isInteger(input.selectionStart) ? input.selectionStart : value.length;
    const end = Number.isInteger(input.selectionEnd) ? input.selectionEnd : start;
    const before = value.slice(0, start);
    const after = value.slice(end);
    const prefix = before && !/\s$/.test(before) ? '
' : '';
    const suffix = after && !/^\s/.test(after) ? '
' : '';
    const inserted = `${prefix}${text}${suffix}`;
    input.value = `${before}${inserted}${after}`;
    const caret = before.length + inserted.length;
    input.setSelectionRange?.(caret, caret);
    const EventCtor = document?.defaultView?.Event || root.Event;
    if (typeof EventCtor === 'function') {

      if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(runtime.snapshot?.characters || {}, name)) {
        runtime.activeCharacter = name;
        runtime.characterProfileSetupName = name;
        runtime.characterProfileCustomOpen = false;
      }
    }
    renderStatePanelKeepingDrafts(document);
    const panel = document.getElementById(CONFIG.panelId);
    if (panel?.querySelector('.ls-body')) panel.querySelector('.ls-body').scrollTop = 0;
    return true;
  }

  function buildModernNeedRow(name, key, need) {
    const stage = NEED_STAGES.has(need.stage) ? need.stage : '';
    const anchor = key === 'sleep' ? need.wake_at : need.last_at;
    const labels = { drink: '上次饮水', meal: '上次进食', urination: '上次排尿', bowel_movement: '上次排便', sleep: '起床时间' };
    const duration = inlineNeedDuration(key, need);
    const meta = [anchor ? `${labels[key]} · ${anchor}` : '', duration ? `${key === 'sleep' ? '清醒' : '已过'} ${duration}` : ''].filter(Boolean);
    if (key === 'sleep' && need.sleeping) meta.splice(0, meta.length, '正在睡眠');
    if (!meta.length) meta.push(`初始状态 · ${formatDuration(initialNeedOffsetForDisplay(name, key, need))}`);
    const notes = [need.notes, need.sleep_information].filter(Boolean).join(' · ');
    return `<article class="ls-modern-need" data-need="${key}" data-stage="${NEED_STAGE_ROUTE_IDS[stage] || ''}"><span class="ls-modern-need-icon">${modernUiIcon(key)}</span><div class="ls-modern-need-copy"><strong>${escapeHtml(NEED_LABELS[key])}</strong><div class="ls-modern-need-meta">${escapeHtml(meta.join(' · '))}</div>${notes ? `<p>${escapeHtml(notes)}</p>` : ''}</div><span class="ls-modern-stage">${escapeHtml(stage || '未定')}</span><span class="ls-need-echo" aria-hidden="true">${modernUiIcon('echo_'+key)}</span></article>`;
  }

  function buildModernInlineDetails(name, character) {
    const needs = NEED_KEYS.filter(key => isPlainObject(character.needs?.[key]));
    return `<div class="ls-modern-inline-details"><div class="ls-modern-inline-needs">${needs.map(key => buildModernNeedRow(name, key, character.needs[key])).join('')}</div><button class="ls-modern-edit" type="button" data-action="modern-edit-character" data-character-name="${escapeHtml(name)}">${modernUiIcon('edit')}编辑档案</button></div>`;
  }

  function handleRestraintAction(button) {

      runtime.playLibrarySearch = '';

      if (!entry) return false;

      const same = previous?.entry_id === entry.id;
      runtime.playDraft = same ? previous : { kind: 'restraint', entry_id: entry.id, variant_id: entry.variants[0]?.id || '', character: previous?.character || playApplicationCharacters()[0] || '', partner_character: '', detail: '' };

      const draft = runtime.playDraft;
      if (draft?.kind !== 'restraint' || !restraintEntry(draft.entry_id)?.variants.some(item => item.id === button.dataset.variantId)) return false;
      runtime.playDraft = { ...draft, variant_id: button.dataset.variantId };
    } else if (action === 'select-restraint-partner') {
      if (runtime.playDraft?.kind !== 'restraint') return false;

    const pendingConceptionNoticeKeys = new Set(Object.entries(storedConceptionEvents).filter(([, entry]) => entry.notice_pending).map(([key]) => key));
     
    let conceptionEventLedger = {};
    let activeConceptionDecisions = {};
    const sexualDesireBaselines = sanitizeSexualDesireBaselines(stored?.sexual_desire_baselines);
    let sexualDesireProfiles = {};
    let staminaProfiles = {};
    let branchSession = { counter: 0, current: null };
    let latest = null;
    let previousValidSnapshot = null;
    let lastCheckedResult = null;
    const replayManual = (snapshot, boundary, inclusive) => {
      if(manualCursor>=manualRows.length) return {snapshot,changed:false};
      const view = { ...stored, snapshot:cloneJson(snapshot), modules: rebuildModules, character_profiles: rebuildCharacterProfiles,
        effect_dismissals: effectDismissals, archives, daily_anchor_archives: dailyAnchorArchives,
        conception_event_ledger: conceptionEventLedger, conception_decision_ledger: conceptionDecisionLedger,
        active_conception_decisions: activeConceptionDecisions, stamina_profiles: staminaProfiles, sexual_desire_profiles:sexualDesireProfiles };
      let changed = false;
      while (manualCursor < manualRows.length) {
        const row = manualRows[manualCursor], id = row.anchor?.message_id ?? -1;
        if (inclusive ? id > boundary : id >= boundary) break;
        applyManualRow(view,row);
        for(const patch of row.patches) if(patch.path[0]==='snapshot' && patch.path.length===3 && !patch.after_exists) manualSeedNames.delete(patch.path[2]);
        manualCursor++; changed = true;
      }
      if (changed) {
        normalizeManualProjection(view,snapshot);
        rebuildCharacterProfiles = sanitizeCharacterProfiles(view.character_profiles);
        effectDismissals = sanitizeEffectDismissals(view.effect_dismissals);
        archives = sanitizeArchiveMap(view.archives);
        dailyAnchorArchives = sanitizeDailyAnchorArchives(view.daily_anchor_archives);
        conceptionEventLedger = sanitizeConceptionEventLedger(view.conception_event_ledger);
        conceptionDecisionLedger = sanitizeConceptionDecisionLedger(view.conception_decision_ledger);
        activeConceptionDecisions = sanitizeActiveConceptionDecisions(view.active_conception_decisions,conceptionDecisionLedger);
        staminaProfiles = sanitizeStaminaProfiles(view.stamina_profiles);
        sexualDesireProfiles = sanitizeSexualDesireProfiles(view.sexual_desire_profiles, sexualDesireBaselines);
        runtime.characterProfiles = rebuildCharacterProfiles;
      }
      return {snapshot:view.snapshot,changed};
    };
    for (const message of assistantMessages) {
      const beforeManual = replayManual(previousValidSnapshot,Number(message.message_id),false);
      previousValidSnapshot = beforeManual.snapshot;
      if (beforeManual.changed && latest) latest.result.snapshot = previousValidSnapshot;
      if (manualRecords.length) {
        allowedNames = modelCharacterNames({ ...stored, snapshot:previousValidSnapshot, character_profiles:rebuildCharacterProfiles });
        if(allowedNames) for(const name of manualSeedNames) allowedNames.add(name);
      }
      const provenance = {
        source_message_id: Number(message.message_id),
        source_swipe_id: Number.isInteger(message.swipe_id) ? message.swipe_id : null,
      };
      const externalLedgerEntry = externalLookup.get(message);
      const externalStateText = externalLedgerEntry?.raw_state_block || '';
      const stateSourceText = externalStateText || inlineStateText(message, stored, messages);
      const rawArchive = extractRawReproductiveArchiveState(stateSourceText, allowedNames);
      if (rawArchive.ok) {
        for (const profile of Object.values(rebuildCharacterProfiles)) {
          if (profile.manual_observation !== 'away') continue;
          if (rawArchive.snapshot?.characters) delete rawArchive.snapshot.characters[profile.name];
          rawArchive.archiveDeletions = rawArchive.archiveDeletions.filter(name => name !== profile.name);
          rawArchive.reproductiveModuleDeletions = rawArchive.reproductiveModuleDeletions.filter(item => item.name !== profile.name);
        }
        logCleanupWarnings(rawArchive.warnings, `分支原始生殖楼层 ${message.message_id}`);
        const rawOperations = applyArchiveOperations(
          archives,
          archiveTombstones,
          rawArchive.snapshot,
          rawArchive.archiveDeletions,
          provenance,
          rawArchive.reproductiveModuleDeletions,
        );
        archives = rawOperations.archives;
        archiveTombstones = rawOperations.tombstones;
      }
      const result = processLifeStateTextFlexible(stateSourceText, rebuildEffectiveModules, previousValidSnapshot, allowedNames, dailyAnchorArchives, externalLedgerEntry?.change_evidence?.ended_reproductive, rebuildCharacterProfiles);
      lastCheckedResult = result;
      if (!result.ok) {
        if (result.code !== 'missing_block') {
          logStateError('branch_snapshot_skipped', `楼层 ${message.message_id}：${result.error}`);
        }
        const manual = replayManual(previousValidSnapshot,Number(message.message_id),true);
        previousValidSnapshot = manual.snapshot;
        if (manual.changed && latest) latest.result.snapshot = previousValidSnapshot;
        continue;
      }
      if (result.blockCount > 1) {
        logStateError('multiple_blocks', `楼层 ${message.message_id} 检测到 ${result.blockCount} 个状态块；重建时采用最后一个。`);
      }
      manualSeedNames.clear();
      rebuildCharacterProfiles = reconcileProfileObservation(rebuildCharacterProfiles, result.snapshot, externalLedgerEntry?.change_evidence || null, previousValidSnapshot);
      runtime.characterProfiles = rebuildCharacterProfiles;
      logCleanupWarnings(result.warnings, `分支楼层 ${message.message_id}`);
      const sceneWarnings = [];
      const sceneResult = reconcileSceneSession(result.snapshot, {
        nsfw_session_counter: branchSession.counter,
        nsfw_session_id: branchSession.current,
      }, sceneWarnings);
      result.snapshot = sceneResult.snapshot;
      branchSession = { counter: sceneResult.counter, current: sceneResult.current };
      logCleanupWarnings(sceneWarnings, `分支楼层 ${message.message_id}`);
      result.snapshot = preserveDormantCycleRecords(
        result.snapshot,
        previousValidSnapshot || result.snapshot,
        rebuildCycleEnabled,
        result.archiveDeletions,
      );
      const progressWarnings = [];
      const needAnchorUpdates = collectNeedAnchorUpdates(previousValidSnapshot, result.snapshot);
      result.snapshot = reconcileNeedTimes(result.snapshot, previousValidSnapshot, progressWarnings);
      result.snapshot = applyNeedStageFloors(result.snapshot, progressWarnings);
      dailyAnchorArchives = updateDailyAnchorArchives(
        dailyAnchorArchives,
        result.snapshot,
        result.detectedModules || rebuildModules,
        provenance,
        { pruneMissing: true },
      );
      const conceptionTurn = reconcileConceptionTurn(
        result.snapshot, previousValidSnapshot, conceptionEventLedger,
        conceptionDecisionLedger, activeConceptionDecisions,
        provenance, progressWarnings, (externalLedgerEntry?.conception_updates || []).filter(item => !allowedNames || allowedNames.has(item.character)), options.randomFn || randomUnit,
        result.reproductiveModuleDeletions,
      );
      conceptionEventLedger = conceptionTurn.eventLedger;
      const decided = { snapshot: conceptionTurn.snapshot, ledger: conceptionTurn.decisionLedger, active: conceptionTurn.activeDecisions, notices: conceptionTurn.notices };
      logCleanupWarnings(progressWarnings, `分支楼层 ${message.message_id}`);
      result.snapshot = applyPregnancyAwarenessEdits(decided.snapshot, rebuildPregnancyAwarenessEdits, message, conceptionEventLedger);
      result.snapshot = reconcileCyclePresence(result.snapshot, previousValidSnapshot, stored?.cycle_presence_enabled === true, rebuildEffectiveModules);
      conceptionDecisionLedger = decided.ledger;
      activeConceptionDecisions = decided.active;
      conceptionEventLedger = reconcileConceptionAwarenessLedger(conceptionEventLedger, result.snapshot, decided.notices);
      if (result.detectedModules?.sexual_desire === true) {
        const sexualDesireState = reconcileSexualDesireProfiles(
          sexualDesireProfiles,
          sexualDesireBaselines,
          result.snapshot,
          previousValidSnapshot,
          result.sexualDesireUpdates,
          provenance,
          rebuildCycleEnabled,
        );
        sexualDesireProfiles = sexualDesireState.profiles;
      }
      const receipt = staminaReplayReceipt(stored, message, manualIndex, result, externalLedgerEntry);
      if (receipt) staminaProfiles = settleStamina(staminaProfiles, result.snapshot, previousValidSnapshot, receipt.updates, receipt.modules, receipt.identity.prefix_sha256, progressWarnings);
      logCleanupWarnings(progressWarnings.filter(warning => warning.includes('体力未结算')), `分支楼层 ${message.message_id}`);
      result.snapshot = replayManual(result.snapshot,Number(message.message_id),true).snapshot;
      if (rebuildModules.reproductive) {
        const activeOperations = applyArchiveOperations(
          archives,
          archiveTombstones,
          result.snapshot,
          result.archiveDeletions,
          provenance,
          result.reproductiveModuleDeletions,
        );
        archives = activeOperations.archives;
        archiveTombstones = activeOperations.tombstones;
      }
      const timelineDeltaHours = calculateTimelineDelta(previousValidSnapshot?.timeline, result.snapshot?.timeline);
      latest = { message, result, provenance, timelineDeltaHours, needAnchorUpdates };
      previousValidSnapshot = result.snapshot;
    }

    const tailManual = replayManual(previousValidSnapshot,manualLimit,true);
    previousValidSnapshot = tailManual.snapshot;
    if (tailManual.changed && latest) latest.result.snapshot = previousValidSnapshot;
    const feedbackIssue = branchStateUpdateIssue(assistantMessages.at(-1), lastCheckedResult, messages);
    if (latest) {
      for (const [key, entry] of Object.entries(conceptionEventLedger)) {
        if (pendingConceptionNoticeKeys.has(key)) entry.notice_pending = true;
      }
      const restoreWarnings = [];
      let rebuiltSnapshot = snapshotForModules(latest.result.snapshot, rebuildEffectiveModules);
      rebuiltSnapshot = restoreDailyAnchorsIntoSnapshot(rebuiltSnapshot, dailyAnchorArchives, rebuildEffectiveModules, restoreWarnings);
      rebuiltSnapshot = ensureActiveCharacterProfiles(rebuiltSnapshot, rebuildCharacterProfiles, rebuildEffectiveModules, stored?.snapshot);
      logCleanupWarnings(restoreWarnings, '分支重建日常锚点');
      if (rebuildEffectiveModules.sexual_desire) {
        sexualDesireProfiles = reconcileSexualDesireProfiles(
          sexualDesireProfiles,
          sexualDesireBaselines,
          rebuiltSnapshot,
          rebuiltSnapshot,
          {},
          latest.provenance,
          rebuildEffectiveModules.reproductive,
        ).profiles;
      }
      const saved = await saveLastValidSnapshot(rebuiltSnapshot, adapter, latest.provenance, {
        clearManualPending: true, manualProjectionLimit: manualLimit, projectManualPending: manualPendingStart!==Infinity && manualLimit===Infinity,
        cyclePresencePreviousSnapshot: rebuiltSnapshot,
        archives,
        dailyAnchorArchives,
        archiveTombstones,
        effectDismissals,
        effectMode: rebuildEffectMode,
        conceptionDecisionLedger,
        conceptionEventLedger,
        activeConceptionDecisions,
        sexualDesireProfiles,
        sexualDesireBaselines,
        timelineDeltaHours: latest.timelineDeltaHours,
        staminaProfiles,
        modules: rebuildModules,
        activePlayIds: rebuildPlayIds,
        playLibraryEnabled: rebuildPlayLibraryEnabled,
        playCombinations: rebuildPlayCombinations,
        externalPendingQueue: rebuildExternalPendingQueue,
        sessionState: branchSession,
        workflowMode: rebuildWorkflowMode,
        externalPreflightEnabled: rebuildExternalPreflightEnabled,
        userTrackingEnabled: rebuildUserTrackingEnabled,
        trackedUserName: rebuildTrackedUserName,
        externalStateLedger: rebuildExternalStateLedger,
        characterProfiles: rebuildCharacterProfiles,
        pregnancyAwarenessEdits: rebuildPregnancyAwarenessEdits,
      });
      runtime.snapshot = saved;
      runtime.hasSnapshot = true;
      rememberSnapshotBranch(saved, latest.provenance, messages, adapter, manualIndex);
      runtime.stateUpdateFeedback = { sourceMessageId: Number(latest.message.message_id), issue: feedbackIssue };
      runtime.needAnchorUpdates = latest.needAnchorUpdates;
      refreshStatePanel();
      return {
        found: true,
        snapshot: saved,
        messageId: Number(latest.message.message_id),
        swipeId: Number.isInteger(latest.message.swipe_id) ? latest.message.swipe_id : null,
        source: 'active_chat',
      };
    }

    const manualSnapshot = previousValidSnapshot || ensureActiveCharacterProfiles(null, rebuildCharacterProfiles, rebuildEffectiveModules, manualRecords.length ? null : stored?.snapshot);
    if (manualSnapshot !== null) {
      const saved = await saveLastValidSnapshot(manualSnapshot, adapter, {}, {
        clearManualPending: true, manualProjectionLimit: manualLimit, projectManualPending: manualPendingStart!==Infinity && manualLimit===Infinity,
        archives, dailyAnchorArchives, archiveTombstones, effectDismissals, effectMode: rebuildEffectMode,
        conceptionDecisionLedger, conceptionEventLedger, activeConceptionDecisions, sexualDesireProfiles, sexualDesireBaselines,
        staminaProfiles,
        modules: rebuildModules, activePlayIds: rebuildPlayIds, playLibraryEnabled: rebuildPlayLibraryEnabled,
        playCombinations: rebuildPlayCombinations, externalPendingQueue: rebuildExternalPendingQueue,
        userTrackingEnabled: rebuildUserTrackingEnabled, trackedUserName: rebuildTrackedUserName,
        characterProfiles: rebuildCharacterProfiles,
      });
      runtime.snapshot = saved;
      runtime.hasSnapshot = true;
      runtime.snapshotBranchProof = null;
      runtime.stateUpdateFeedback = { sourceMessageId: null, issue: feedbackIssue };
      runtime.needAnchorUpdates = [];
      refreshStatePanel();
      return { found: true, snapshot: saved, source: 'manual_profiles' };
    }
    const pendingManualSnapshot = await saveNoValidSnapshot(adapter, { clearManualPending: true, manualProjectionLimit: manualLimit, projectManualPending: manualPendingStart!==Infinity && manualLimit===Infinity, archives, dailyAnchorArchives, archiveTombstones, effectDismissals, effectMode: rebuildEffectMode, conceptionDecisionLedger, conceptionEventLedger, activeConceptionDecisions, sexualDesireProfiles, sexualDesireBaselines, staminaProfiles, modules: rebuildModules, activePlayIds: rebuildPlayIds, playLibraryEnabled: rebuildPlayLibraryEnabled, playCombinations: rebuildPlayCombinations, externalPendingQueue: rebuildExternalPendingQueue, userTrackingEnabled: rebuildUserTrackingEnabled, trackedUserName: rebuildTrackedUserName, characterProfiles: rebuildCharacterProfiles });
    runtime.snapshot = pendingManualSnapshot || null;
    runtime.snapshotBranchProof = null;
    runtime.hasSnapshot = Boolean(pendingManualSnapshot);
    runtime.stateUpdateFeedback = { sourceMessageId: null, issue: feedbackIssue };
    runtime.needAnchorUpdates = [];
    refreshStatePanel();
    return { found: runtime.hasSnapshot, snapshot: runtime.snapshot, source: 'active_chat' };
  }

  async function findLatestBranchSnapshot(adapter = runtime.adapter, options = {}) {
    if (!adapter?.listMessages) return { found: false, unavailable: true, messages: [] };
    const messages = await adapter.listMessages();
    let stored = await readStoreWithContentDefaults(adapter);
    if (stored?.external_smooth_enabled === true) stored = await syncExternalSmoothHistory(adapter, messages);
    restoreExternalSmooth(stored, adapter);
    const storedModules = modulesFromStore(stored, adapter?.getStoreSource?.() || 'vnext');
    const scanModules = modulesWithPlayRequirements(storedModules, normalizeActivePlayIds(stored?.active_play_routes));
    const assistantMessages = (Array.isArray(messages) ? messages : [])
      .filter((message) => message?.role === 'assistant' && typeof message.message === 'string')
      .sort((left, right) => Number(left.message_id) - Number(right.message_id));
    if (options.excludeLastAssistant && assistantMessages.length > 0) assistantMessages.pop();
    const externalLookup = createExternalLedgerLookup(stored?.external_state_ledger || runtime.externalStateLedger, assistantMessages);
    let feedbackIssue = null;
    for (let index = assistantMessages.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
      const message = assistantMessages[index];
      const result = processLifeStateTextFlexible(externalLookup.get(message)?.raw_state_block || inlineStateText(message, stored, messages), scanModules, null, modelCharacterNames(stored));
      if (index === assistantMessages.length - 1) feedbackIssue = branchStateUpdateIssue(message, result, messages);
      if (!result.ok) continue;
      return {
        found: true,
        result,
        message,
        messages,
        messageId: Number(message.message_id),
        swipeId: Number.isInteger(message.swipe_id) ? message.swipe_id : null,
        feedbackIssue,
      };
    }
    return { found: false, messages, feedbackIssue };
  }

    const loaded = await loadLastValidSnapshot(adapter);
    const archiveIndexMatches = loaded.archiveIndexSourceMessageId === loaded.sourceMessageId;
    const currentStore = await adapter.getStore() || {};
    const manualCacheMatches = !manualHistory(currentStore).length || currentStore.manual_projection_key === manualProjectionKey(currentStore,latest.messages,
      options.excludeLastAssistant ? Math.max(-1,...latest.messages.filter(row=>row.role==='assistant').map(row=>row.message_id)) - 1 : Infinity);
    const sameSource = latest.found
      && loaded.hasSnapshot
      && latest.messageId === loaded.sourceMessageId
      && latest.swipeId === loaded.sourceSwipeId
      && archiveIndexMatches;
    const sameEmptySource = !latest.found && !loaded.hasSnapshot && loaded.archiveIndexSourceMessageId === null;
    const staminaSourceMessage = latest.messages.find(message => Number(message.message_id) === latest.messageId);
    const savedStaminaReceipt = staminaSourceMessage && currentStore.stamina_receipts?.[externalLedgerKey(staminaSourceMessage.message_id, staminaSourceMessage.swipe_id)];
    const staminaCacheMatches = !savedStaminaReceipt || Boolean(staminaReceipt(currentStore, staminaSourceMessage, manualBranchIndex(latest.messages)));
    const branchCacheMatches = sameEmptySource || (sameSource && snapshotBranchMatches(loaded.snapshot, loaded.sourceMessageId, latest.messages, adapter));
    if (branchCacheMatches && manualCacheMatches && staminaCacheMatches) {

      runtime.pendingRestore = loaded.pendingRestore;
      runtime.formatBoostPending = loaded.formatBoostPending;
      runtime.formatBoostAlwaysOn = loaded.formatBoostAlwaysOn;
      runtime.nsfwEnhancementEnabled = loaded.nsfwEnhancementEnabled;
      runtime.bodyExpressionEnabled = loaded.bodyExpressionEnabled;
      runtime.modules = loaded.modules;

      runtime.formatBoostAutoActive = loaded.workflowMode === WORKFLOW_MODES.INLINE && !hasValidSnapshotAfterFirstUser(latest.messages, {
        excludeLastAssistant: options.excludeLastAssistant,
        modules: modulesWithPlayRequirements(runtime.modules, runtime.activePlayIds),
      });
      runtime.stateUpdateFeedback = { sourceMessageId: loaded.hasSnapshot ? loaded.sourceMessageId : null, issue: latest.feedbackIssue || null };
      refreshStatePanel();

  async function injectBeforeGenerationCore(adapter, generationType, dryRun, queued) {
    if (generationType === 'quiet') return;
    runtime.promptRequest?.stopLayoutObserver?.();
    const request = { plan: null, dryRun: dryRun === true };
    runtime.promptRequest = request;
    runtime.promptPlan = null;
    if (dryRun && runtime.promptCapture?.deferUntilDryRunComplete) runtime.promptCapture.request = request;
    try {
      if (!queued) await runtime.queue;
      assertStateOperation(adapter);
      if (runtime.promptRequest !== request) return;
       
      runtime.promptAnchors = null;
      runtime.nativeMiddleMode = 'none';
      await clearPublishedPrompt(adapter);
      if (runtime.promptRequest !== request) return;
      if (!dryRun) await syncTrackedUserName(adapter);
      const excludeLastAssistant = generationType === 'regenerate' || generationType === 'swipe';
      if (excludeLastAssistant && runtime.externalBackgroundJob) {
        runtime.externalBackgroundJob.invalidated = true;
        runtime.externalControl.controller?.abort();
        runtime.externalControl.controller = null;
      }

(function bootstrapTavernHelper(root) {
  'use strict';

  const api = root.LifeStateCore.createLifeStateSystem(root, {
    kind: 'helper',
    createAdapter: (overrides) => api.createTavernHelperAdapter(overrides),
    bindPageLifecycle(destroy) {
      if (typeof root.$ === 'function') {
        root.$(root).on('pagehide.lifeStateContinuity', destroy);
        return () => root.$(root).off('pagehide.lifeStateContinuity', destroy);
      }
      if (root.addEventListener) {
        root.addEventListener('pagehide', destroy, { once: true });
        return () => root.removeEventListener?.('pagehide', destroy);
      }
      return undefined;
    },
  });

  if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) module.exports = api;
  const publish = () => { root.LifeStateContinuity = api; root.RPE_DEBUG = api.debugPrompts; };

  if (root.document) {
    const ticket = {};
    root.__lifeStateHelperStartTicket = ticket;
    const start = async () => {
      try {
        if (root.__lifeStateHelperStartTicket !== ticket) return;
        const previous = root.__lifeStateContinuityController;
        if (previous?.ownershipProtocol === 1 && previous.kind === 'helper') {
          await previous.destroy();
        }
        if (root.__lifeStateHelperStartTicket !== ticket) return;
        root.__lifeStateContinuityController = api.init();
        publish();
      } catch (error) {
        try { (root.top?.toastr || root.toastr)?.warning?.(error.message); } catch (_) {   }
        console.error('[LifeState] 初始化失败；正文不会受影响。', error);
      }
    };

     
    if (typeof root.$ === 'function') {
      root.$(start);
    } else if (root.document.readyState === 'loading') {
      root.document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', start, { once: true });
    } else {
      start();
    }
  } else publish();
})(typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? globalThis : window);

SillyTavern · Regex Preset Binder

预设绑定正则（Regex Preset Binder）

为 SillyTavern 带来“把正则脚本内置到预设”的能力，并提供与原生一致的管理体验与一键切换。

预设内置正则

原版不支持“正则随预设一并加载”。本插件让预设作者可在预设中内置配套正则，用户载入预设即自动可用。

完整 UI 控制

和原生正则面板一致的体验：启用/禁用、编辑、导入/导出、排序、批量选择等，一应俱全。

一键快速切换

点击按钮即可在“全局 <→ 预设”之间移动脚本，随时绑定或解绑。

快速上手

  1. 安装此脚本（你已经完成了）
  2. 打开 设置 → Regex，你会看到新增的 “预设绑定正则” 区域。
  3. 使用 导入预设正则 或 新建预设正则 配置配套规则。
  4. 通过“⬆ 绑定到预设 / ⬇ 移回全局”按钮在两域快速切换。
  5. 拖拽排序，保存即可。
// 在“全局脚本”项中会出现“绑定到预设”按钮：
// 点击后 -> 从 extensions.regex 移除，加入预设列表（并持久化至 prompts）。
// 反向操作“移回全局”同理。
提示：预设数据以 JSON 字符串形式保存在 chatCompletionSettings.prompts 的标识 regexes-bindings 下。

FAQ

预设绑定正则突然无法拖动了怎么办？

关掉此脚本再打开即可。

能否批量删除预设绑定项？

由于酒馆前端代码的硬性限制，目前不支持批删。可单条删除或移回全局后再批量处理。

# 角色描写
## 在角色**首次出场**时，应对角色的外观进行细致描绘，从发型发色到服装配饰，写出让角色产生区分度的每一个细节。以下是几个优质示例：
- 虚江子眼中一亮，只见那名女子一身男装打扮，相貌俊美，更有一股女子中罕见的勃发英气，配上一身白衣如雪，就算上头沾染鲜血，仍显得神采不凡

- 赤城子端坐蒲团上，手持拂尘，身穿深蓝色道袍，头戴太极法冠，背后的墙壁上悬挂着一柄长剑，模样看来甚是英武，剑眉朗目，三络短须，颇有出尘脱俗之态，确实是一副世外高人的气派，当得起河洛剑派掌门的尊贵身份

- 对方脸很白净，五官秀气，吐息带香，似兰似麝，手指纤细，左大拇指上还带着一枚扳指，扳指却不是玉的，而是铁的，铁上显现出了花纹，还有扣槽，并不装饰用的，而是用来射箭的。

- 视线上移，停留在青衣女子那张完美无瑕的精致脸颊之上，白哲的肌肤犹如吹弹可破般，泛着许些健康而动人的红润，脸颊之上，噙着一抹轻柔笑容，让人有种如沐春风般的柔和感觉，仿佛只要看到她的笑容。心中的种种焦虑，便是会在顷刻间荡然无存一般，充满着异样的魔力
## 角色在新场景再次出场时，也要再进行一次外观描绘，但可以只保留部分最核心的特征一起入镜，不必再次完整描写
## 编排角色对白时，要先结合性格模拟角色内心想法，然后通过对白表达出来。不要直接将内心的想法写出来

# 场景描写
## 镜头切换到新场景时，对整个场景进行详细描绘。由远及近，先整体后局部，如同电影运镜一样，先描绘场景的整体景观，然后再推进到主角所在的局部
## 在剧情过程中，也可以通过场景特写适时烘托情绪氛围

# 动作描写
## 描写角色动作时，分远景、近景和特写，远景可把整个动作一笔带过。近景描写时，将动作拆分并依次写出。对于特写，在描写拆分动作的基础上进一步描写细节，包括动作的力度、节奏和角色相应部位的外观描写。
## 无论是远景、近景还是特写，都绝不能直接写出动作所蕴含的情绪或内心想法。情绪应通过节奏编排自然流露。

# 情绪表达
## 角色的情绪、场景的氛围、故事的整体基调…… 一切都不应直接写在表面上。在剧情中的每一部分通过五感的描写，将情绪藏在可见的物理特征下面。
## 角色的情绪体现在动作和语言中，场景的氛围融入到环境里，在动作和语言后不要解释它们蕴含的情绪或想法。
## “声音带着一丝不容置疑的意味”，“话语中带着一丝不易察觉的愤怒”…… 此类的表达需要极力避免，不容置疑和愤怒应该体现在台词内容和动作里，而不是直接写出来。此外，如果只有一丝、如果不易察觉，那就不要写出来，不要以上帝视角替读者解读本应隐蔽的细节。

# 段落编排
## 剧情段落有起 承 转 合，一个场景、一段剧情不能无止境的继续下去。
## 剧情段落间要有直接的分界，一整段剧情内容结束后，直接用---分隔并开始新的段落。（是整段大的剧情节点结束，不要滥用分隔）
## 整个剧情节点还没结束，但本段正文结束的时候，直接在最后一个角色动作/对白切断即可，不需要像“夜晚才刚刚开始”这样的收束
## 开始新剧情节点或进入新场景时，参考场景描写指南从整体引入局部。从段中接续剧情时，不要一定以场景描写开头，自然承接上文内容即可。
## 在开始写作之前，要判断自己处于当前剧情的什么阶段，适当主动推进进度以防一段剧情一直写不完。
说完了！

<<<|catgodml|menu:输出格式模块:📏<options>行动选项>>>
在剧情结束后给出3个符合以下要求的行动选项：
  - 紧密衔接前文剧情，选项需自然合理，推动后续剧情。
  - 选项应简洁、细节精炼，引导不同走向。
  - 风格多样化，贴合当前剧情的创意风格。比如在性场景中可包含：温柔、主动、被动、玩闹、利用环境、轻度支配 、情趣玩法、高潮冲刺等。
  - 避免重复动作/语言/事件。
  - 可加入 {{user}} 的语言。
  - 选项前加 emoji (如 😏,😈,🥺,😂,🥵 等) 表达 {{user}} 意图/情绪。
  - 最多包含一个负面/强制性选项。
  - 每条选项包裹于<option>标签中
格式：
<options>
<option>选项1</option>
<option>选项2</option>
<option>选项3</option>
</options>
